claim_zh: Temporal 把"停止"拆成两条事件：WorkflowExecutionCancelRequested（请求已记录）与 WorkflowExecutionCanceled（客户端已确认取消并真的停了），另有 WorkflowExecutionTerminated 表示强杀；活动层同样有 ActivityTaskCancelRequested / ActivityTaskCanceled 一对。
mechanism_en: Event History records `WorkflowExecutionCancelRequested` — "A request has been made to cancel the Workflow Execution" — and separately `WorkflowExecutionCanceled` — "The client has confirmed the cancelation request and the Workflow Execution has been canceled." Forceful stop is a distinct event, `WorkflowExecutionTerminated`, where workflow code gets no chance to run. Activity-level pair: `ActivityTaskCancelRequested` / `ActivityTaskCanceled`. `RequestCancelExternalWorkflowExecutionInitiated` covers cross-workflow cancel.
why_it_works_zh: 请求与确认是历史里两条独立、可查询的事件，而不是一个可变的布尔字段。任何观察者（UI、CLI、告警）都能区分"我发了停止"和"它真的停了"，而且强杀被显式建模成第三种终态，不会和优雅取消混为一谈。
orrery_mapping: 直接印证 Mobius 的 stopRequestedAt / stopAckedAt 两列设计是对的，并给出应当补齐的第三态：Orrery 的 AgentRun 需要 stop_requested / stop_acked / force_terminated 三种终态分开记录，且 force_terminated 必须显式标注"清理逻辑未执行"。取消必须写进运行台账（评论尾标 kind/status 里加 stop_phase），而不是只改一个字段。

mechanism_en: TypeScript: `CancellationScope.cancellable(fn)`, `CancellationScope.nonCancellable(fn)`, `CancellationScope.withTimeout(timeout, fn)`; properties `consideredCancelled` ("A non-cancellable scope can never be considered cancelled") and `cancelRequested` ("A Promise that throws when a cancellable scope receives a cancellation request, either directly or indirectly"). Go: `workflow.NewDisconnectedContext(ctx)` "creates a context for executing cleanup activities after cancellation", used inside `defer` guarded by `errors.Is(ctx.Err(), workflow.ErrCanceled)`; `ActivityOptions.WaitForCancellation: true` makes the caller wait for the activity to actually finish cancelling. Activities only learn about cancellation through heartbeats: "Activities must heartbeat to receive cancellations from a Temporal Service", requiring `HeartbeatTimeout` to be set.
why_it_works_zh: 这是"闩锁"问题的正确解法：取消传播有边界，边界内的清理路径被结构性地豁免。同时取消的"送达通道"是心跳而不是另一条控制通道——没有心跳就收不到取消，把"活着"和"能被叫停"绑成同一件事，杜绝了半死不活的运行既停不下来又不报错。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的停止实现要有等价的 disconnected 上下文：闩锁释放、Slack 收尾播报、临时凭据回收这三条清理路径必须运行在"不可被本次取消打断"的作用域里，直接回应"两次生产对话永久失声"那次事故。并且把"agent 必须心跳才可被取消"写死进运行契约：无心跳的 run 一律按不可控处理，走强杀路径并标注清理未执行。

claim_zh: Hatchet 把"排队等待"和"执行中"拆成两个独立超时（schedule_timeout 默认 5 分钟、execution_timeout 默认 60 秒），并给任务一个主动续租的 API ctx.refresh_timeout()，让长任务用续租而不是把超时调大来活着。
mechanism_en: Two timeout types: scheduling timeout (default 5 minutes — time queued before cancellation) and execution timeout (default 60 seconds). Identifiers: Python `schedule_timeout` / `execution_timeout` / `ctx.refresh_timeout()`; TS `scheduleTimeout` / `executionTimeout` / `ctx.refreshTimeout()`; Go `hatchet.WithExecutionTimeout()` / `ctx.RefreshTimeout()`. Durations are strings (`10s`, `4m`, `1h30m`). "Timeouts in Hatchet are treated as failures and the task will be retried if specified", with the explicit caveat that "A timed out task does not guarantee that the task will be stopped immediately."
why_it_works_zh: 排队超时与执行超时分开，能区分"没人来拿这个活"（worker 池问题）和"拿了但跑太久"（任务问题）——这是两种完全不同的告警。refresh_timeout 是租约续期语义：默认收得很紧（60 秒），需要长跑的任务必须显式、反复地证明自己还在干活。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 agent run 采用同一套双超时：enqueue_timeout（委派后多久没有 runtime 接手就告警并重新委派）与 execution_timeout；把 maxSessionSeconds=900 改造成"默认短 + 显式续租"，让一个跑 40 分钟的部署必须每隔几分钟主动续一次租，而不是把上限一次性调到 2400 秒。注意抄的时候要补上 Hatchet 自己承认的缺口：超时不保证立刻停住，所以续租失败后仍要走带确认的停止链路。

claim_zh: Temporal 的成本治理止步于 Namespace 级：计费单位是 Action，账单 API 只能按 Namespace 与 tag 归集，唯一接近实时的东西是 OpenMetrics 指标 temporal_cloud_v1_billable_action_count（1 分钟粒度、带 temporal_workflow_type 维度、约 3 分钟延迟）；没有 per-run 成本字段，也没有任何按成本硬停的机制。
mechanism_en: Billing API granularity is "Hourly, daily, monthly", attributed by Namespace and user-defined tags (team/env/workload/cost-center), read in real time and retroactively re-attributable. Near-real-time signal is the OpenMetrics counter `temporal_cloud_v1_billable_action_count`, 1-minute granularity, dimensions `action_type` and `temporal_workflow_type`, available within ~3 minutes. Actions are billed per Namespace, not per Workflow Execution, and cover eight categories (Workflow / Activity / Timer / Signal / Query / Update / Schedule / Nexus) including "recording a Heartbeat". Explicitly absent: per-workflow-execution cost fields, per-run cost exposure, hard stops on execution based on cost; current-month data is "provisional until the billing month closes". Budget alerting (90% / 100% / 110% of allocation) is something the customer builds from the Billing API, not a product feature.
why_it_works_zh: 值得抄的只有两件事：用 workflow_type 维度把用量拆开（能回答"哪类 run 在烧钱"），以及在创建租户/命名空间时强制打 tag（成本归属不能事后补）。但整体是反面教材——业界最成熟的 durable execution 内核也把成本当成账单问题而不是运行时问题，所以成本硬停必须在内核之外实现。
orrery_mapping: L4 内核不要指望它管钱。Orrery 保留 Mobius 已有的四级预算（run/agent/owner/team）与三重独立硬停，成本字段与 AgentRun 同事务写入——这正是"30 天成本靠扫 3000 条评论推导而静默少报"的修复方向。可以抄的是 action 分类思想：把 agent run 的成本拆成 turns / tool_calls / tokens / wallclock 四类分别计量并带 agent_kind 维度；以及"创建时强制打 owner/team tag"这条约束。差异化明确：Orrery 要有 Temporal 没有的"触顶即硬停且必须响"。

claim_zh: Temporal 把一次活动执行的每个阶段写成独立事件（Scheduled / Started / Completed / Failed / TimedOut / CancelRequested / Canceled），"被调度""被拿起""完成"是三条不同的记录，而不是一个 status 字段的覆盖写。
mechanism_en: Event History is "an append-only log of Events for your application"; activity lifecycle emits `ActivityTaskScheduled`, `ActivityTaskStarted`, `ActivityTaskCompleted`, `ActivityTaskFailed`, `ActivityTaskTimedOut`, `ActivityTaskCancelRequested`, `ActivityTaskCanceled` as separate events. why_it_works_zh: 阶段独立成事件之后，"投递了但没成功""拿起了但超时"在数据层就是可区分的，不需要靠日志文本猜。append-only 还意味着一次失败的尝试不会被后来的成功覆盖掉——重试历史天然保留。
orrery_mapping: 直接对应"Slack channel_not_found 但 job 成功 → 这三件事分开报"。Orrery 的 AgentRun 不能只有一个 status 列，要有 append-only 的 run_events 表：deploy_scheduled / deploy_started / deploy_succeeded / notify_attempted / notify_delivered 各自一行，告警规则按事件组合而不是按终态写。投递失败进自己的死信队列并可单独重试，不影响部署本身的终态。

claim_zh: Temporal 的审批门就是一行 await workflow.wait_condition(lambda: self.approved_for_release)：workflow 在等待期间完全不占 worker，状态留在服务端历史里，审批通过 @workflow.signal 或带校验器的 @workflow.update 送进来。
mechanism_en: `@workflow.signal` (async, mutates state, no return), `@workflow.query` (sync read, plain `def`), `@workflow.update` (trackable, can mutate and return, with an optional `@<handler_name>.validator` that rejects the Update *before* it is written to history). Client side: `WorkflowHandle.signal()`, `.execute_update()`, `.start_update()`, and signal-with-start via `client.start_workflow(..., start_signal="submit_greeting", start_signal_args=[...])`. Durable wait: `await workflow.wait_condition(lambda: self.approved_for_release)`; "Workflows remain in history without consuming worker resources while waiting." `workflow.all_handlers_finished` guards against terminating with in-flight handlers.
why_it_works_zh: 审批不是一个轮询的定时任务，而是一个挂起的续体。成本为零（不占 worker），语义为一（等待条件写在业务代码里，读代码就知道在等什么）。update validator 是个被低估的设计：不合法的审批请求在写历史之前就被拒，台账里不会堆满垃圾。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的"部署需人工批准"应当是 L4 里一个一等的挂起态而非一个 pending 表 + cron 轮询：agent run 挂起在 await approval，Slack 按钮或 PR review 作为 signal 打进来，超时用第二个条件（wait_condition 加 timeout）触发升级。validator 对应"审批者≠请求者"的校验——在写台账之前就拒绝自我审批，而不是事后审计。

claim_zh: Hatchet 的等待带"回看窗口"：ctx.aio_wait_for_event(key, expression, scope, lookback_window) 在注册等待时会先回看最近的事件，消除"事件比等待先到"的竞态；配合 EvictionPolicy，等待中的 durable task 会被踢出 worker 槽位。
mechanism_en: Python `ctx.aio_wait_for_event(key, expression, scope, lookback_window, payload_validator)`; TS `ctx.waitForEvent(eventKey, celExpression, schema, scope, lookbackWindow)`; Go `ctx.WaitForEvent(key, expression, WithEventScope(), WithConsiderEventsSince())`; Ruby `ctx.wait_for(key, Hatchet::UserEventCondition.new(event_key:, expression:))`. Matching uses CEL over the event payload (e.g. `input.user_id == '1234'`). "Even if the task is interrupted and requeued while waiting, the event will still be processed." Slot release is governed by an `EvictionPolicy` with `ttl` (minimum wait before eviction), `allowCapacityEviction: true` (optimistic eviction when the worker needs slots) and `priority` (lower evicted first); on resume Hatchet "replays its event log up to the checkpoint where eviction occurred."
why_it_works_zh: lookback_window 解决的是所有"等审批"系统都会踩的竞态：审批人手速比 agent 注册等待还快。把回看做成等待原语的参数，而不是让每个调用方自己去查历史表，这是把正确性收进内核。eviction 的 ttl+priority 让"释放槽位"成为可配置策略而不是隐式行为。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的审批等待必须带 lookback：agent 委派出去、Slack 消息发出去、人在 agent 注册等待之前就点了批准——这条路径要能自愈。抄 CEL 表达式匹配：审批事件用 approval.run_id == ... && approval.approver != approval.requester 直接在内核层过滤，把"审批者≠请求者"下沉成表达式而不是应用代码。同时抄 Hatchet 自己的告诫：resume 会重放业务逻辑，所以挂起点之前的副作用必须幂等。

claim_zh: Temporal 用 Data Converter + Payload Codec 让服务端只看得到密文 Payload，再用一个自己部署的 Codec Server（/encode、/decode、/download 三个 POST 端点）按需为 UI 和 CLI 解密，并在文档里明确警告这台服务器一次 API 调用就能解出敏感数据、必须限制访问。
mechanism_en: `DataConverter` interfaces per SDK (`go.temporal.io/sdk/converter#DataConverter`, `io.temporal.common.converter.DataConverter`, `temporalio.converter.DataConverter`, `common.DataConverter`); a custom Payload Codec layers encryption/compression on top. "All your sensitive data exists in its original format only on hosts that you control." Codec Server is "an HTTP server that uses your custom Codec logic to decode your data remotely", exposing POST `/decode`, `/encode`, and `/download` (the last only for External Storage). Web UI points at it via Namespace settings or a per-browser "Configure Codec Server" override; CLI via `temporal env set --codec-endpoint "http://localhost:8888"` and `--codec-auth` for the authorization header, with "Pass access token" to forward a JWT. mechanism_en: Idempotency key = "a CEL expression that is evaluated against the input and additional metadata", must evaluate to a string. mechanism_en: `workflow.patched("my-patch")` inserts a marker into Event History; on replay a Worker that encounters the marker fails the Workflow Task if the code does not produce the same marker. `workflow.deprecate_patch("my-patch")` writes a marker that does *not* cause replay failure when absent. Four-step lifecycle: (1) introduce `patched()` branching old and new code; (2) after all pre-patch Workflows have left retention, deploy `deprecate_patch()`; (3) remove the old branch keeping only new code; (4) deploy Workers with neither call. Commands that cannot be reordered without versioning include timers, activity/child-workflow scheduling, `Patched`/`GetVersion` calls, search-attribute upserts, and `SideEffect`/`MutableSideEffect`.
why_it_works_zh: 这是"只增不改的契约"的工程化版本：变更不是就地改语义，而是在历史里留一个显式的版本分叉标记，老历史沿老分支重放、新历史走新分支，两者在同一份代码里共存到老运行自然消亡为止。四步法把"什么时候可以删旧代码"和保留期绑定，给了一个可判定的终止条件而不是靠拍脑袋。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署流程定义会持续变（加健康检查、换跳板机）。抄 patched 的形状：workflow 定义里用 orrery.patched("add-known-hosts-preflight") 分叉，正在跑的部署继续走老路径，新的走新路径；"破坏性变更走新路径"这条已有原则得到一个具体载体。关键收获是第 2 步的判据——旧分支的删除时间由"最老的在跑 run 的保留期"决定，Orrery 要把这个时间点算出来并自动提醒，否则补丁会永远堆积。

claim_zh: Temporal 的 Worker Deployment Versioning 让 workflow 在定义上声明 Pinned 或 Auto-Upgrade：Pinned 的运行保证在同一个 Deployment Version 上跑完，配合 Current / Ramping（0-100% 灰度）路由和 Inactive→Active→Draining→Drained 四态排空，把"老代码什么时候能下线"变成可观测状态。
mechanism_en: A Worker Deployment groups Workers; a Deployment Version = deployment name + Build ID, "Workers that share the same code build and environment". Routing: Current Version (default for new workflows), Ramping Version ("configurable percentage of Workflows are routed to", 0-100), Target Version derived from Current/Ramping plus Workflow ID. Drainage states: Inactive → Active → Draining ("has open pinned workflows but stopped being Current/Ramping") → Drained ("All the pinned Workflows that were running on it are closed"). Inheritance: auto-upgrade workflows never inherit; pinned children inherit the parent version; Continue-As-New preserves pinning; cron jobs never inherit. mechanism_en: Overlap policies: `Skip` (default, "Nothing happens; the Workflow Execution is not started"), `BufferOne`, `BufferAll` ("Allows an unlimited number of Workflows to buffer"), `CancelOther`, `TerminateOther`, `AllowAll`. Timezone configurable, defaults to UTC. CLI surface: `temporal schedule create|backfill|update|toggle|trigger|delete|describe|list|list-matching-times`, with flags `--overlap-policy`, `--catchup-window`, `--pause-on-failure`, `--jitter`, `--time-zone`, `--start-time`, `--end-time`, `--remaining-actions`, `--notes`; pause/unpause is `toggle --pause` / `--unpause`. verify_note_zh: **降级到 C：卡片把一个已被官方标记为 Legacy 的组件当作值得抄的现行设计，且完全没提。**页面 <title> 与所有 og/twitter meta 逐字都是「Approval (Legacy) integration」。两个动作的描述确实逐字属实（「Pauses the flow and wait for the approval from the user」/「Create links only without pausing the flow, use wait for approval to pause」，2 actions 0 triggers），MIT 许可证的引文我在 activepieces repo 根 LICENSE 逐字证实（但同样不在 evidence_url 上，且 LICENSE 版权年份止于 2024）。**关键遗漏**：Activepieces 官方 breaking-changes 文档指示用户从旧 Todos/Approval 迁移到「new approvals channels available from the approvals tab in the piece selector」，另有独立的 Human Input piece（activepieces.com/pieces/forms）。所以卡片抄的「拆成两个动作」这个形状很可能已经被厂商自己废弃了——抄一个被废弃的设计而不知道它被废弃，是本轮调研最危险的一处。形状本身（mint → deliver → await 三段分离）的论证仍然成立且对 D6 有价值，但必须以「我们自己的推论」而非「Activepieces 现行做法」的身份写进 Orrery。**维度映射也可商榷**：卡片标 D7，但它的 why_it_works_zh 通篇论证的是 D6（投递≠成功≠综合），实际主张属于 D6，D7 只是载体。

claim_zh: Hatchet 的暂停不是一个全局开关，而是按触发来源分别指定行为：暂停一个 workflow 后，cron 与 scheduled 触发各自可选 QUEUE（建 run 但挂住）或 DROP（整个跳过），事件与手动触发则强制 QUEUE，队列里的 run 有默认 24 小时的 queue_ttl。
mechanism_en: "Pausing a workflow stops new runs of that workflow from starting"; in-flight runs continue. APIs: `pause()` / `aio_pause()`, `unpause()` / `aio_unpause()`. Per-source behavior parameters: `paused_workflow_cron_run_queue_behavior` and `paused_workflow_scheduled_run_queue_behavior`, each accepting `QUEUE` (create the run and hold it) or `DROP` (skip the trigger entirely). Event and manual triggers always queue and cannot be dropped. `queue_ttl` bounds how long queued runs survive — default 24 hours, expressed as a `timedelta` or duration string (`"30m"`).
why_it_works_zh: "暂停"在不同触发源下的正确语义本来就不同：定时报表停机期间攒 12 份没有意义（该 DROP），但人点的部署请求绝不能被无声丢掉（必须 QUEUE）。把这个选择做成显式参数而不是隐式默认，避免了运维暂停后不知道恢复时会发生什么。queue_ttl 则防止恢复瞬间涌出一堆过期任务。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 需要"维护窗口暂停"这个动作（升级 L4、换部署密钥）。抄这套三分法：cron 类 job 用 DROP，scheduled 一次性任务用 QUEUE，人委派给 agent 的工单强制 QUEUE 且 queue_ttl 设短（比如 2 小时）并在过期时回写工单告知请求人。这正面回应"投递≠成功"：暂停期间被 DROP 的触发必须留一条记录，不能真的消失。

claim_zh: Windmill 把「审批」实现为流程步骤的 suspend 属性：步骤挂起后靠 required_events 计数的密钥 resume URL 恢复，timeout 到点自动取消，approver 可被要求是登录用户、禁止自批、限定组，审批表单还能用 default_args/dynamic_enums 在运行时动态填充。
mechanism_en: A FlowModule gains a `suspend` object with `required_events` (exact number of approvals needed before resume), `timeout` (seconds, after which the flow auto-cancels), `hide_cancel`, and `continue_on_error` (disapproval/timeout falls through to the next step with an `error` field in the payload instead of failing the flow). Inside the step, `wmill.getResumeUrls(approver, flowLevel)` / `wmill.get_resume_urls()` mints approve/resume/cancel secret URLs — possession of the URL is the bearer credential. `flow_level=true` stores the approval on the parent flow so a pre-approval can satisfy a later suspend step. Approval pages can carry a JSON-Schema form whose values land in `resume["arg"]`; `default_args` and `enums` are computed at runtime by the step itself. Cloud/EE adds "Require logged-in approvers", "Disable self-approval" (enforced at UI *and* API level), and group-scoped approvers, and exposes the `approvers` array of who actually approved.
why_it_works_zh: 它把「等人」变成引擎的一等状态而不是脚本里的 while 循环：超时、计数、失败降级都是声明式字段，重启引擎不丢挂起状态。更关键的是 continue_on_error 让「被否决/超时」是一条可编排的分支，而不是一个异常——这正是部署审批需要的语义（拒绝 ≠ 系统故障）。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署审批直接抄 suspend 三元组：requiredApprovers 计数 + timeoutSeconds + onTimeout(deny|proceed)。但 secret-URL-as-bearer 要改掉——FeedMob 的审批必须落在 Slack 已登录身份上，采用 Windmill EE 的两条规则：approver 必须是已认证主体、且 approver ≠ requester 在 API 层强制（不只是 UI 灰掉按钮）。flow_level 预审批的概念可以用来做「本次发版预先批准后续三个环境」。

verify_note_zh: 六条事件定义逐字核对全部通过（WorkflowExecutionCancelRequested/Canceled/Terminated、ActivityTaskCancelRequested/Canceled、RequestCancelExternalWorkflowExecutionInitiated），是本批证据最干净的一张。两点必须写进卡片否则会误导：(a) 'the client has confirmed' 里的 client 指 SDK/worker 侧的 workflow 代码，不是人类操作者——这是'引擎确认取消已生效'，不是'人确认停了'；(b) 这两条是事件历史里的记录，不是外部可订阅的 ack 通道，Orrery 要做到'确认停止'仍须自建存活/心跳判定。等级只能 B：纯厂商文档，零独立用户来源。

claim_zh: Windmill 不让非工程师写表单：它解析 main 函数的参数签名生成 JSON Schema，再从 Schema 渲染 UI；作者只需在脚本里加类型注解和 advanced settings（title/placeholder/enum/format），运营侧看到的就是一个带校验的表单。
mechanism_en: "By analyzing the parameters of the main function, Windmill generates an input specification for the script or flow in the JSON Schema format. Windmill then renders the UI for the Script or Flow from that specification." The author never edits JSON Schema by hand; it is "the result of the analysis of the script parameters of the main function and the optional UI customization." Per-argument advanced settings (custom title, placeholder, per-type field settings, enums, formats) refine both the UI and the emitted Schema. Windmill-specific "special types" (e.g. resource types) render as pickers rather than raw text. The documented path for handing this to operators is to wrap it in an App; the fallback is sharing the script plus the variables it depends on.
why_it_works_zh: 表单的真源是代码签名，所以表单永远不会和脚本参数漂移——改一个参数名，UI 自动跟着改，没有第二份要维护的表单定义。对广告运营来说，他们看到的是下拉框和必填校验，而不是 YAML；对工程师来说，成本是加一行类型注解。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的「部署服务」页面不要手写表单。从部署脚本的入参签名（repo、branch、target、dry_run）自动生成，target 用 resource-type 风格的选择器直接绑定到部署目标对象。这一步是全员可用的前提：销售和运营能自己触发部署预演，而不必找工程师。
product: Windmill (windmill-labs/windmill)
verify_note_zh: 张冠李戴。TS 半边（cancellable / nonCancellable / withTimeout / consideredCancelled 的 'A non-cancellable scope can never be considered cancelled' / cancelRequested 的原文）在该 URL 上核对通过；但 claim_zh 的另一半——NewDisconnectedContext、ActivityOptions.WaitForCancellation、'Activities must heartbeat to receive cancellations'——在该页**一个字都没有**。我另行取证确认这些说法为真，出处是 https://docs.temporal.io/develop/go/cancellation （原文 'Ensure that the Activity is Heartbeating to receive the Cancellation request and stop execution'，CleanupActivity 跑在 disconnected context 的 defer 里）。必须补第二条 URL，否则这张卡按引用不成立。另修正一处过度推广：只有 Activity 层取消依赖心跳送达，Workflow 层取消由服务端写历史送达、不需要心跳——orrery_mapping 里'agent 必须心跳才可被取消'对 workflow 级不成立，照抄会把一个正常挂起等审批的 run 误判为不可控并强杀。

claim_zh: Windmill 用 wmill.yaml + wmill sync pull/push 把整个工作区（脚本/流程/应用/资源/权限）序列化成文件树，并支持按 git 分支自动选工作区，让「本地开发」和「线上工作区」是同一份定义的两端。
mechanism_en: `wmill init` generates a fully commented `wmill.yaml`. It carries `includes`/`excludes` path globs, skip flags (`skipSecrets: true` by default, `skipVariables`, `skipResources`, `includeSchedules`, `includeTriggers`), and a `workspaces:` map where each entry has `baseUrl`, `workspaceId`, `gitBranch` and per-target `overrides`. Active workspace resolution order: `--workspace <name>` flag → current git branch matched against `gitBranch` entries → local profile from `wmill workspace switch`; `wmill workspace bind` pins it. Flows/apps land in `<path>__flow/` and `<path>__app/` directories. Item-level ACLs round-trip as `extra_perms` in the metadata file (`g/data_team: true` = writer, `u/alice: false` = viewer). `wmill instance pull/push` clones users, groups and settings across whole instances.
why_it_works_zh: 权限（extra_perms）和调度（includeSchedules）也进了文件，所以 code review 能看到「谁被授权跑这个」的变更，而不只是脚本逻辑变更。gitBranch→workspace 的自动绑定消除了「我以为我在 staging」这类事故。skipSecrets 默认 true 意味着默认不会把密钥拖进 git。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 orrery.yaml 直接照抄这个骨架：includes/excludes + per-environment overrides + gitBranch 绑定。特别要抄的是把权限写进文件——Orrery 的「哪个 agent 能触发哪个部署目标」必须是 PR 里能 review 的一行 diff，而不是后台点一下。这也是 D20（agent 只能经 PR 改自动化）的物理基础。

verify_note_zh: 5m/60s 默认值、'treated as failures and the task will be retried if specified'、以及那句关键的自承缺口 'A timed out task does not guarantee that the task will be stopped immediately. The task will be stopped as soon as the worker is able to stop the task' 全部核对通过。一处语义必须改：refresh_timeout 不是'租约续期(重置时钟)'，文档明说是**叠加**——'the new timeout is added to the existing timeout'。叠加意味着反复续租会单调抬高上限、永远不收敛，所以照抄时必须额外加一条不可续的绝对墙钟硬停，否则比现在的 maxSessionSeconds=900 更危险。未在该页确认的细节：Go 侧 hatchet.WithExecutionTimeout()、duration 字符串格式（10s/4m/1h30m）。维度上这条跨 D4/D6，归 D4 可接受。

claim_zh: Windmill 的密钥不是环境变量而是按路径授权的对象：脚本里只出现 $var:NAME / $res:PATH 占位符，worker 在执行那一刻用作业级 WM_TOKEN 换取明文，解密动作写一条 variables.decrypt_secret 审计事件，日志里超过 8 字符的密文自动只留前 3 位其余打星。
mechanism_en: All variables (secrets and non-secrets alike) are encrypted with a workspace-specific symmetric key. Resources and scripts store only interpolated placeholders — `$var:<NAME>`, `$res:<RESOURCE_PATH>`, `$WM_*` — so "the secret itself never enters the history"; version history holds the reference, not the value. At job time the worker resolves them using an ephemeral `WM_TOKEN` passed as an env var to that job. Every decryption emits a `variables.decrypt_secret` entry into the audit log. Job logs are masked before persistence: for strings of 8+ characters everything after the first three chars becomes `*****`. Access is path-scoped exactly like every other object: `u/alice/secret` is private unless shared, `f/devops/secret` follows folder read permissions. Resources also expose "Clear past versions" to purge rotated credentials from history.
why_it_works_zh: 三件事叠起来才有效：①密钥不在代码里（占位符）②按步注入且有作用域（per-job token + path ACL）③用掉了会留痕（decrypt_secret 审计事件）。第三条是大多数平台缺的——出事后你能回答「哪次运行读了这个密钥」。日志自动打码则挡住了最常见的泄露路径：print(config)。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署密钥（SSH key、EC2 凭据）按这个模型建：脚本里写 $res:f/deploy/prod_ec2，agent 的上下文里永远看不到明文（直接满足章程「密钥不进模型上下文」）。decrypt_secret 审计事件要接进 Mobius 的运行台账，成为 AgentRun 的一个子事件。日志打码规则（>8 字符留前 3）可以原样抄进 Orrery 的日志管道。

verify_note_zh: 被它自己引用的文档部分反驳。该页的 granularity 表明确把 'Actions in Event History' 列为 **Per Workflow Execution** 可用、用途是 'Estimating Actions for a specific execution'——所以'止步于 Namespace 级''唯一接近实时的只有 OpenMetrics 指标'是夸大。同时卡片漏掉了该页最重要、且最强化其结论的一句：'temporal_cloud_v1_billable_action_count is a usage estimate, not your bill. It doesn't account for storage, support fees, pricing-tier calculations, some features (TRUs, Fairness), or rounding.'——这恰恰说明该指标根本不能当硬停判据。'90/100/110% 预算告警需自建''当月数据 provisional until the billing month closes' 两条未在该页证实。准确表述应为：有 per-execution 的 Action 计数估算，没有 per-run 的美元成本字段，也没有任何按成本阻断执行的机制。结论方向（avoid，成本硬停必须在内核之外做）成立，但取证质量降 C。

claim_zh: Windmill 的存活检测是 worker 对每个 job 持续打 ping，server 每 30 秒扫一遍；超过 ZOMBIE_JOB_TIMEOUT 没 ping 的 job 被判定为僵尸，按 RESTART_ZOMBIE_JOBS 决定原地重启（保留同一 UUID）还是判失败；他们甚至专门加了一个心跳协程覆盖「执行器轮询循环还没起来」的空窗期。
mechanism_en: README documents `ZOMBIE_JOB_TIMEOUT` (default 30; "the timeout after which a job is considered to be zombie if the worker did not send pings about processing the job (every server check for zombie jobs every 30s)") and `RESTART_ZOMBIE_JOBS` (default true; "if true then a zombie job is restarted (in-place with the same uuid and some logs), if false the zombie job is failed"). `backend/src/monitor.rs` reads the env var with a `"60"` fallback. `backend/windmill-worker/src/worker_utils.rs` defines `JobPingHeartbeat`, whose doc comment states it "keeps the job's ping fresh during phases that run before the executor's own polling loop starts (volume setup, s3object materialization, ...). Without it, a slow wait or download with no ping in between can exceed ZOMBIE_JOB_TIMEOUT (default 60s) and get the job falsely restarted as a zombie." A matching "Mute zombie job restart alerts" instance setting exists on the critical-alerts path.
why_it_works_zh: 它承认了租约模型的真实失败模式：不是「进程死了」，而是「进程活着但忙到没空打卡」。JobPingHeartbeat 那条注释就是踩坑记录——不给慢启动阶段补心跳，就会误杀正常作业。README 写 30、代码 fallback 写 60，这个不一致本身也是提醒：默认值必须只有一处真源。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 agent run 租约照抄：leaseExpiresAt + 独立心跳协程，且心跳必须覆盖「工具调用阻塞中」这类长空窗（FeedMob 的 agent 一次 WebFetch 就可能几十秒）。RESTART_ZOMBIE_JOBS 这个开关对 agent 必须默认 false——重启一个已经花了钱、可能已经部署了一半的 agent run 是危险的，僵尸 agent 应该判失败并升级给人，而不是原地重来。
product: Windmill (windmill-labs/windmill)
verify_note_zh: 三处引用（'An append-only log of Events for your application'、七个 ActivityTask* 事件枚举、'A Side Effect does not re-execute upon replay, but instead returns the recorded result'）逐字核对通过。一处必须打标：orrery_mapping 里'投递失败进自己的死信队列'**不是从 Temporal 抄来的**——Temporal 没有 activity 级 DLQ 原语（只有重试策略与 reset），这是 Orrery 自创，不能标成 copy，否则会误以为有现成实现可参照。另与 index 12 在'append-only event history'上主张重复，建议合并，把 index 12 改写成纯硬限制卡。

claim_zh: Windmill 把停止拆成两级：cancel 是协作式（worker 收到后自己收尾，在 completed_job 上写 canceled / canceled_by / canceled_reason），force_cancel 是强制的独立 API 端点；两者都按「能不能读这个 job」同一把锁鉴权，且分别记 jobs.cancel 与 jobs.force_cancel 两种审计操作。
mechanism_en: Two distinct endpoints exist: `POST /w/{workspace}/jobs_u/queue/cancel/{id}` and `POST /w/{workspace}/jobs_u/queue/force_cancel/{id}`, both taking a `reason`. In `backend/windmill-queue/src/jobs.rs` the cancel path carries a `force_cancel: bool` and branches on `if force_cancel || (job_running.parent_job.is_none() && !job_running.running)` — i.e. a job that is actually *running* is only killed outright when force is set; otherwise it is asked to stop. The outcome is persisted on the run record as `canceled`, `canceled_by`, `canceled_reason`. Audit log operations are enumerated separately as `jobs.cancel`, `jobs.force_cancel` and `jobs.disapproval`. `backend/tests/jobs_read_auth.rs` documents and tests the authz invariant: "`queue/cancel` and `queue/force_cancel` are gated by that same access [as reading], so a viewer cannot kill a run hidden from them while its owner still can" — knowing a run's UUID is not sufficient to kill it. Share links are read-only and explicitly cannot cancel, force-cancel or resume a suspended step.
why_it_works_zh: 「请求停止」和「强杀」是两个不同的、分别留痕的动作，这正是 FeedMob 那次「紧急停止导致两次生产对话永久失声」的教训所指向的结构。而且他们把「知道 UUID ≠ 有权杀」写成了一个有测试覆盖的不变式——这一点比文档重要得多，因为停止接口天然是最容易被当成「反正是止损操作，放宽点」的地方。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 stopRequestedAt/stopAckedAt 两列已经比 Windmill 更明确（Windmill 没有独立的 acked 时间戳，只有终态）。要补抄的是两条：①force 必须是独立端点和独立审计动作，不能是 cancel 的一个布尔参数混在一起记账；②停止权限按「能读这个 run」同一把锁，且分享链接一律只读——Orrery 里 agent run 的分享链接绝不能带停止能力。
product: Windmill (windmill-labs/windmill)
verify_note_zh: signal/query/update 三分、validator 'When a Validator raises an error, the Update is rejected and WorkflowExecutionUpdateAccepted won't be added to the Event History'、wait_condition 的 approved_for_release 示例、all_handlers_finished 均核对通过。但 mechanism_en 里加引号的 'Workflows remain in history without consuming worker resources while waiting' **在该页找不到**——属性本身为真（Temporal 的等待/定时器不占 worker，可由 timers 文档另行取证），但被当成该页原文引用是不严谨的，要么去引号要么补出处。start_signal/start_signal_args、start_update 的精确签名也未在该页确认。最关键的推论纠偏：Temporal 只提供'挂起原语'，'审批者≠请求者'完全是应用层代码；把 update validator 说成能承担这条约束是 orrery 的设计推论而非文档事实，且 validator 本身不知道谁是请求者，需要把 requester 写进 workflow 状态才谈得上校验。

claim_zh: Windmill 的运行台账是一张表一行：completed_job 同时带输入(args)、输出(result)、日志(logs)、流程状态(flow_status)、资源消耗(duration_ms/mem_peak)、代码指纹(script_hash)、以及关键的双身份字段 created_by 与 permissioned_as（谁触发 vs 以谁的权限跑）。
mechanism_en: Jobs live in exactly two tables and move between them: queued jobs ordered by `scheduled_for`, and completed jobs. "Workers fetch jobs from the queue, start executing them, atomically set their state in the queue to 'running', stream the logs while executing them." The completed record's documented fields include `workspace_id`, `id` (UUID), `created_by`, `email`, `permissioned_as` (explicitly distinct from `created_by`), `created_at`/`started_at`, `duration_ms`, `mem_peak`, `job_kind`, `language`, `args`, `result`, `result_columns`, `logs`, `flow_status`, `workflow_as_code_status`, `is_flow_step`, `parent_job`, `success`, `canceled`/`canceled_by`/`canceled_reason`, `script_hash`, `script_path`, `schedule_path`, `priority`, `labels`, `tag`, `visible_to_owner`. The Runs UI filters over the same row (path, user, folder, worker, concurrency key, labels, trigger type, args, results) and offers bulk cancel/force-cancel/re-run, with re-run able to rewrite inputs via a JS expression. Self-hosted OSS retention is capped at 30 days; EE is unlimited.
why_it_works_zh: created_by 与 permissioned_as 分离是整个模型的核心：一次运行既知道「谁按的按钮」，也知道「以哪个主体的权限在跑」。加上不可变的 script_hash，这一行就能回答「什么代码、谁授权、拿什么输入、跑出什么、花了多久多少内存」——重放所需的一切都在同一行，不需要去日志里考古。
orrery_mapping: 这正是 Orrery 的 AgentRun 表应该长的样子，且把 FeedMob 现有的「评论是真源 + AgentRun 同事务镜像」保留：Windmill 缺的正是人可读那一面（它只有结构化行，没有人类叙事）。Orrery 应该是 completed_job 的字段集 ∪ Mobius 的 HTML 注释尾标。注意抄 permissioned_as：agent run 必须同时记 delegatedBy(人) 和 runningAs(agent)。另外 30 天 OSS 保留上限是个警告——成本与合规窗口要自己定，不要继承默认值。

verify_note_zh: 一半在、一半不在。lookback_window（文档明说用于 'prevent race conditions'，且需要在 wait 与 event 两侧都设 scope）、CEL payload 匹配、以及 'Even if the task is interrupted and requeued while waiting, the event will still be processed' 核对通过；卡片漏了该页的一条限制：Ruby SDK 的 lookback 标注 coming soon。但 EvictionPolicy / ttl / allowCapacityEviction / priority / '重放 event log 到 eviction 发生的 checkpoint' 这一整段**不在该 URL**，真实出处是 https://docs.hatchet.run/v1/task-eviction ，而且卡片漏了那里最该抄的默认值：TTL 15 分钟、AllowCapacityEviction=true、Priority=0。必须拆成两条 URL 才成立。

claim_zh: Windmill 有两个独立的「没变就别跑」原语：cache_ttl 按输入缓存结果直接跳过执行，以及 job debouncing——默认以「workspace + 路径 + 全部入参」作为去重键，新来的同键作业取消掉还在等的那个并重置计时器，还能把多次触发的数组参数累积成一批。
mechanism_en: `cache_ttl` is a FlowModule/script field: "If the same runnable is re-triggered with the same input within this duration, Windmill instantly retrieves the cached result." Separately, job debouncing (shipped in v1.566.1, configured under Settings → Runtime settings) exposes: **Debounce delay** (seconds to wait before executing), **Custom debounce key** (default = workspace ID + runnable path + all argument values), **Max debouncing time** (ceiling on how long a job may stay debounced), **Max debounces amount** (counts debounce events rather than elapsed time), and **Debounce args to accumulate** (name an array-typed argument whose values are collected across the debounced batch). Semantics: "incoming jobs with the same debounce key cancel the pending job and reset the timer" — the cancelled job never runs; only the final accumulated batch does. Debouncing is on by default for dependency jobs.
why_it_works_zh: 两者解决的是不同问题：cache_ttl 答「这个结果我已经算过了」，debounce 答「先别动，可能还有更多事件要来」。Max debouncing time 和 Max debounces amount 这对上限很重要——纯 debounce 在高频事件下会饿死作业，必须有「最多憋多久/憋多少次就必须跑」的天花板。
orrery_mapping: FeedMob 现有的 cron 三段链（脚本写内容哈希状态文件 → LLM job 哈希未变时 no-op）本质是手搓的 cache_ttl。Orrery 应该把它提升为引擎原语：每个 run 计算 inputFingerprint，未变则记一条 status=noop 的运行记录（而不是不记）。debounce 则直接对应「部署请求连续推三次」的场景：同 repo+branch 的部署请求应该 debounce 合并，且必须带 maxDebounceMs 上限。

verify_note_zh: 三端点（/encode、/decode、/download）、Web UI 与 CLI 配置（--codec-endpoint、--codec-auth、转发 JWT）、以及 'access to a production Codec Server should be restricted' 的告警均核对通过。需要补一条卡片自己在末尾承认、却没写进 claim 的边界：Codec 只解决传输与存储中的机密性，明文仍完整存在于 worker 主机内存和模型上下文里——所以这张卡不能被当成 D8 的答案，'密钥不进模型上下文'必须另外实现。另提醒 Orrery 侧的取舍：一旦 payload 加密，Temporal 自己的 Visibility/搜索、以及按内容做幂等判定都会失效，抄之前要想清楚哪些字段留明文。

claim_zh: Windmill 把流程定义抽成独立于产品的 OpenFlow 规范（Apache-2.0，spec 文件 openflow.openapi.yaml 是真源），脚本作业按不可变 script_hash 执行，依赖靠专门的 dependency job 生成锁文件——契约、代码指纹、依赖锁三件事都是显式产物。
mechanism_en: OpenFlow is "an open standard for defining 'Flows'" — a DAG where each node is a step — with Windmill as "the open-source reference implementation"; the spec lives as `openflow.openapi.yaml` in the repo and the OpenAPI/OpenFlow files are Apache-2.0 (the rest of `backend/` is AGPLv3, per the repo LICENSE). Root object: `summary` (required), `description`, `value` (a FlowValue), `schema` (JSON Schema constraining inputs). FlowValue: `modules`, `failure_module`, `preprocessor_module`, `same_worker`. FlowModule: `id`, `value` (rawscript | script | flow | forloopflow | …), `input_transforms` ("mapping between fields … to either a static JSON value, or a raw JavaScript expression"), plus `stop_after_if`, `skip_if`, `sleep`, `cache_ttl`, `mock`, `suspend`, `retry`, `continue_on_error`. Script jobs "execute scripts using an immutable hash"; dependency jobs exist specifically to "generate lockfiles to ensure consistent dependency versions".
why_it_works_zh: 规范用比引擎更宽松的许可证（Apache-2.0 vs AGPL）发布，意味着你的流程定义可以在引擎之外存活——这是「契约先于代码」在许可证层面的落实。script_hash 不可变 + 锁文件让「同样的输入在两个月后重跑」是可确定的，而不是看依赖解析当天的运气。`mock` 作为一等字段则让契约本身可测试。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的运行契约（现在是 HTML 注释尾标）应该同样独立成一份带版本号的 schema 文件，用比实现更宽松的许可证发布，且实现只能只增不改地演进。具体抄三个字段：`mock`（部署流程的 dry-run 是一等字段不是一个入参）、`input_transforms`（上游输出到下游入参的映射是声明式的、可 diff 的）、`failure_module`（失败处理是流程的一部分而不是 catch 块）。script_hash 对应到 Orrery 就是「27 处 action 按可变 tag 引用」必须改成钉 SHA 的同一条原则。

verify_note_zh: CEL 键（'evaluated against the input and additional metadata'，须求值为字符串）、TTL 滑动窗口（'each accepted run resets the clock'）、状态型释放 + fallback TTL（'a safety net: it caps the longest the key can remain claimed if, for some reason, the run never reaches a terminal status'）、IdempotencyCollisionError 携带既有 run id 以便取其输出、事件触发时冲突被吞掉但事件仍被正确摄入——全部逐字核对通过，是本批证据最扎实的 Hatchet 卡。一处未证实：'behaves like CANCEL_NEWEST' 这句该页没有，别当原文引用。抄进 Orrery 时要注意事件触发冲突是**静默**吞掉的，这与 D6'投递≠成功'相冲突，必须自己补一条'被去重的触发也要留痕'。

claim_zh: Windmill 有专门的 service account 主体类型：工作区作用域的自动化身份，没有密码、不能走 SSO、只能通过 token 行动，并单独分配 Operator/Developer/Admin 角色；要让它能部署还得额外加进 wm_deployers 组。此外 operator 角色被硬性剥夺了「跑 preview」的能力。
mechanism_en: Three workspace roles: **Admin** ("can see and edit all scripts, flows, apps, and other entities within the workspace"), **Developer** ("the ability to create and edit scripts, flows and apps" plus read/write on what they create), **Operator** ("restricts authoring and running code" — cannot create/edit/archive/delete scripts, flows, apps, and crucially cannot "run previews", only execute pre-built items within assigned paths/folders). **Service accounts** are "workspace-scoped automation identities that cannot log in directly (no password, no SSO). They act through tokens." A service account still picks one of the three roles; granting it deploy rights requires adding it to the `wm_deployers` group. Permissions are path-scoped (`u/henri/script` vs `f/data_team/script`) with per-item `extra_perms` granting Viewer/Writer to individual users or groups.
why_it_works_zh: 两个设计值得学：①自动化身份在认证层就被切断（无密码、无 SSO），所以没有「用某人的账号跑」这条捷径可走；②operator 不能跑 preview——这是把「执行既有自动化」和「执行任意代码」彻底分开，广告运营点按钮跑部署是安全的，因为他连写一行代码再跑的入口都没有。deploy 能力还要再进一个组，是第二道闸。
orrery_mapping: Mobius 的五种身份已经比这个细（Windmill 的 service account 仍然可以拥有 u/ 路径下的资源，违反 Orrery「agent 不能拥有资源」）。要抄的是 operator 那条硬约束：Orrery 里给广告运营和销售的角色必须「能触发既有部署定义、不能执行任意脚本、不能 preview」，并且这是引擎级约束不是 UI 级。wm_deployers 对应 Orrery 的「能触发生产部署」应该是一个显式的组成员资格，且这个成员资格本身要走 PR（见 D15/D20）。
product: Windmill (windmill-labs/windmill)
verify_note_zh: 两组策略的枚举与定义逐字核对通过（含 UseExisting 'returns a successful response with the Open Workflow Execution's Run Id'）；唯一性原文是 'only one Workflow Execution with a given Workflow Id can be in an Open state at any given time'，卡片转述可接受。但 orrery_mapping 有一处硬错误：这个唯一性只在**单个 Namespace 内**、且只约束 Open 状态，它根本不是主机级互斥——跨 namespace、跨引擎、或有人直接 ssh 上去操作都绕得过。'不需要额外分布式锁'的说法要删。真正该用来补'7 个 workflow 没有 concurrency'的是 Hatchet 的 concurrency key（见遗漏项 1），那才是按任意表达式分组的并发闸门。

claim_zh: Windmill 提供两档进程隔离并且可以按脚本粒度开：ENABLE_UNSHARE_PID 用 PID namespace 挡住 /proc/$pid/mem 和 worker 环境变量，NSJAIL 额外给文件系统、可选网络和资源限制；脚本里写一行 #sandbox 注解即可对单个脚本启用。但两者都默认关闭。
mechanism_en: `ENABLE_UNSHARE_PID=true` enables PID namespace isolation — "prevents jobs from seeing parent worker processes, accessing memory via `/proc/$pid/mem`, reading environment variables, or accessing file descriptors" — requiring `privileged: true` in docker-compose, Linux, and util-linux; `UNSHARE_ISOLATION_FLAGS` customizes it. `DISABLE_NSJAIL=false` enables NSJAIL, which adds filesystem restriction, optional network isolation and resource limits; the nsjail binary ships in all Windmill images and per-language nsjail config files control mounts, rlimits and network. A per-script `#sandbox` annotation works for Python, TypeScript (Bun and Deno) and Bash; all executors (Python, TypeScript, Deno, Go, Bash, Rust, C#, Java, Ansible, PHP, Ruby) respect the instance-level `job_isolation` setting. Workers are one-job-at-a-time processes ("run one script at a time using the entire cpu and memory available to them") routed by `WORKER_GROUP` / `WORKER_TAGS`. Isolation is on by default in the Helm chart but not in docker-compose.
why_it_works_zh: per-script 的 #sandbox 注解是个好设计：隔离等级可以按「这段代码有多可信」逐步收紧，而不是全开或全关的一刀切。worker 一次只跑一个作业则天然消除了同机作业互相污染。缺点见反面证据——默认关闭，且 nsjail 在 CE 是编译期关掉的。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 跑 agent 的爆炸半径比跑脚本大得多（agent 会读网页、会被注入）。抄 per-run 隔离等级这个形状，但把默认值反过来：Orrery 的 agent run 默认最严（无出网、无宿主凭据、按任务作用域 token），要放宽必须在 orrery.yaml 里显式声明并经 PR。#sandbox 注解对应到 Orrery 就是运行定义里的 isolation: strict|network|host 字段。绝不要继承 Windmill「默认关闭 + 文档里提醒你去开」的姿态。

verify_note_zh: 数字与清单两处都不成立。该页的补丁生命周期是 **3 步**不是卡片说的 4 步：1) 用 patched() 让新旧码并存；2) 删旧码并用 deprecate_patch() 标记；3) 等没有旧版在跑之后移除 deprecate_patch()。卡片声称的 'Commands that cannot be reordered without versioning：timers / activity / child workflow / Patched / GetVersion / upsert search attributes / SideEffect / MutableSideEffect' 整段**不在该页**（属 deterministic constraints 另一篇）。另外两条也未在该页证实：'deprecate_patch 写入一个缺失时不会导致重放失败的 marker'、'重放时 marker 不一致会 fail Workflow Task'。机制方向为真，但按引用判定不成立，降 C，需重新取证或改引 deterministic-constraints 页。卡片最有价值的那条推论（旧分支删除时机由最老在跑 run 的保留期决定）在该页只能得到第 3 步的弱支持。

claim_zh: 【Kestra】Kestra 把「漏跑怎么办」做成了一等的三值配置 recoverMissedSchedules(ALL|NONE|LAST)，并且在引擎层保证同一 schedule 的执行不会重叠——上一次没跑完，调度器就等；补跑另有 UI 上的 Backfill executions 按整段时间区间重放。
mechanism_en: The Schedule trigger takes a `cron` (with `@daily`/`@hourly`/`@weekly`/`@monthly`/`@yearly` shortcuts) and an explicit `timezone` property (e.g. `America/New_York`), with the documented caveat to "keep your Kestra server and database timezones aligned". `recoverMissedSchedules` is a global configuration overridable per-trigger with three values: `ALL` (default — recover every missed schedule), `NONE` (skip recovery entirely), `LAST` (recover only the most recent missed one). Overlap is an engine guarantee, not a user concern: "Schedules cannot **overlap**, meaning concurrent schedule executions are not allowed" — if a previous run has not completed, the scheduler waits. Backfill replays missed intervals between a start and end date via the Triggers tab's "Backfill executions".
why_it_works_zh: 这三个值恰好覆盖三种真实语义：幂等的数据任务要 ALL，「只要最新状态」的同步任务要 LAST，不能重复执行的副作用任务要 NONE。把它做成配置而不是让每个作者自己在脚本里判断，意味着这个决策是显式的、可 review 的。重叠保护放在引擎层则消灭了一整类「两个部署同时跑」事故。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 cron 必须有这三个值，且部署类任务默认 NONE（宕机两小时后醒来不应该把积压的 12 次部署全跑一遍）。重叠策略同理放在引擎层，对应 FeedMob 13 个 workflow 里 7 个没有 concurrency 这个具体缺口——Orrery 应该让 concurrency 无法被省略（没写就用安全默认值，而不是不限制）。Backfill 作为显式的人发起动作、区间明确、留痕，是比「手动重推一次」好得多的调试手段。

verify_note_zh: Pinned/Auto-Upgrade（含 'Auto-Upgrade ... need to be kept replay-safe manually, that is with patching' 这条诚实的代价说明）、Current/Ramping/Target 路由、各 SDK 与 Server/CLI 最低版本均核对通过。四态 Inactive/Active/Draining/Drained 在父页上没有定义，但在同文档区子页 https://docs.temporal.io/production-deployment/worker-deployments/worker-versioning/sunset-and-gc 上逐字存在（Draining: 'The version stopped being Current or Ramping, and it has open pinned Workflows running on it'；Drained: '...all the pinned Workflows that were running on it are closed'），建议把 evidence_url 换成子页，否则'Drained 是这里最值钱的概念'这句论证悬空。未证实项需复核：'pinned children inherit the parent version'——父页只说 'Child Workflows of a parent or previous Auto-Upgrade Workflow default to Auto-Upgrade behavior'，方向与卡片不完全一致；'Continue-As-New 保留 pinning''cron 从不继承'两条也未证实。

claim_zh: 【Kestra】每一次 execution 都被引擎自动打上 system.* 标签：system.username（谁触发的）、system.from（怎么被触发的）、system.correlationId（跨 subflow 传播的关联 ID），以及专门区分 AI 触发的 system.mcpServerId / system.mcpSessionId——机器发起和人发起在同一本账上天然可分。
mechanism_en: Kestra injects reserved system labels on every execution: `system.correlationId` "automatically set for every execution and propagated to downstream executions created by `Subflow` or `Loop` tasks"; `system.username` "contains the username of the user who triggered the execution"; `system.from` "automatically set on every execution to indicate how it was triggered"; and `system.mcpServerId` / `system.mcpSessionId` "automatically set on every execution created by a Kestra MCP server". Separately, "every time you save a flow, Kestra creates a new revision", with draft vs published revisions — "Executions do not run against a draft revision", they run against the last published version — and rollback to any previous revision.
why_it_works_zh: 关键在于这些标签是引擎打的，不是作者自觉加的，所以覆盖率是 100%。correlationId 跨 subflow 传播解决了「一次人类意图散成十几次子执行」的追溯问题。而单独给 MCP 来源留字段，意味着他们已经把「这次运行是 AI 发起的」当成一个需要在数据模型里区分的一等事实——这正是 Orrery 的 Q5。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的每条运行记录强制带三个引擎注入字段：triggeredBy(主体 ID)、triggeredVia(human-ui|schedule|webhook|agent|mcp)、correlationId(跨委派链传播)。Kestra 用 mcpServerId/mcpSessionId 区分 AI 来源，Orrery 应该更进一步：agent 发起的 run 必须额外带 delegatedByHuman，把「agent 无法被追责」这条章程落成一个 NOT NULL 约束。draft vs published revision 的区分也值得抄——部署定义的草稿改动绝不能影响正在跑的调度。

verify_note_zh: 引用与主张严重错位，是本批最该重写的一张。该 URL 只支持卡片的'硬限制'半段（10,240/51,200 events、10MB/50MB、blob 256KB/2MB、gRPC 与事务 4MB、pending 默认 2,000 建议 ≤500 —— 这些逐字核对通过）；而 claim_zh 的主干'Event History 是 append-only、兼审计日志、可被 Replayer 做确定性回归测试'在该页**完全不存在**（append-only 出处是 index 4 的 URL，Replayer/from_json 出处是 develop/python/testing）。'Cloud retention 默认 30 天、可配 1-90 天'也不在该页，实际出处是 https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/limits （我已核实存在）。另有一处数字存疑：该页给的是 in-flight Updates 10 / 历史内 Updates 2000、pending signals 默认 2,000，卡片写的 '>10,000 Signals terminates' 未在该页出现。处置建议：把这张拆成两张——'硬限制即设计约束'保留此 URL（这部分反而是对 Orrery 最有用的原创发现），'可重放回归测试'另开一卡并另行取证；与 index 4 重复的 append-only 主张删掉。

claim_zh: 【Activepieces】它把审批拆成两个独立动作而不是一个：Create Approval Links 只生成链接、不暂停流程；Wait for Approval 才真正把流程挂起。想先把链接发出去、晚点再等，和直接原地等，是两件不同的事。
mechanism_en: The Approval piece exposes exactly two actions: **"Wait for Approval"** — "Pauses the flow and wait for the approval from the user" — and **"Create Approval Links"**, which generates approve/disapprove URLs "without pausing the flow" and explicitly tells you to "use wait for approval to pause." The typical pattern is therefore: create links → send them somewhere (Slack, Discord, email) via a separate step → then wait. Activepieces' core is MIT (`LICENSE`: "Content outside of the above mentioned directories … is available under the 'MIT Expat' license"), with `packages/ee/` and `packages/server/api/src/app/ee` under a separate enterprise license.
why_it_works_zh: 拆开的价值在于「生成链接」「投递链接」「等待结果」是三个可以分别失败、分别重试的步骤。如果合成一个动作，Slack 投递失败时你无法区分「没人批」和「消息根本没送到」——这正是 FeedMob 那条 channel_not_found 教训。Windmill 的 requestInteractiveSlackApproval 恰恰是把三件事捆在一起的反例。

mechanism_en: The agent job runs with `permissions: contents: read, actions: read`. Writes are requested by emitting typed JSON objects (e.g. `{"type":"create_issue","title":...}`) through a `safeoutputs` MCP server; a downstream job with the matching scope (`issues: write`, `pull-requests: write`, `security-events: write`…) validates and applies them. Roughly 50 output types exist (`create-issue`, `create-pull-request`, `push-to-pull-request-branch`, `add-comment`, `add-labels`, `create-code-scanning-alert`, `dispatch-workflow`, `update-project`, `jira-create-issue`…), each with a `max:` cap (defaults are tiny: `create-issue` max 1, `add-labels` max 3, `close-pull-request` max 10). Per-type guards include `allowed:`/`blocked:` label globs, `required-labels`, `target: triggering|"*"`, `allowed-repos`, `max-patch-size: "50kb"`, `protected-files`, `allowed-domains` (non-allowlisted URLs are replaced with "(redacted)"), `max-bot-mentions`, and `mentions.allowed/blocked`. If no `safe-outputs:` block is present at all, only `create-issue` auto-enables with `max: 1`.
why_it_works_zh: 因为它把「agent 能做什么」从一个开放的工具空间压成了一份有限枚举 + 每项带数量上限的白名单，而且这份白名单在编译期就固化进 lock 文件、在运行期由另一个进程执行。即使 agent 被注入完全接管，它能造成的最大伤害也已经被 max 值和权限表封顶了——这正是 FeedMob 从工具黑名单改成空白名单时学到的同一件事，只不过 GitHub 把它做到了「写操作」这一层而不只是「工具」这一层。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署服务应该照抄这个两段式：agent job 只读（能读仓库、读 CI 状态、读健康检查），不持有任何可以 ssh 到 EC2 的凭据；agent 只能产出形如 {"type":"deploy","target":"prod-web-1","ref":"<sha>"} 的结构化请求；由一个独立的 deploy-executor job 持有 SSH key 并执行。把 FeedMob 的 safe outputs 清单定义成部署域的动词：deploy / rollback / restart-service / run-migration / scale，每个带 max 与 target allowlist。deploy.yml 681 行里真正危险的部分恰好只有这几个动词，其余 600 多行是可以被编译掉的。

claim_zh: 每次运行的 agent 跑在一个 rootless Docker 沙箱里，出口流量被强制穿过同一个 Docker 网络上的 squid 代理，默认全拒、按域名白名单放行，Docker socket 对 agent 直接隐藏。
mechanism_en: `sandbox: {agent: awf}` enables AWF (Agent Workflow Firewall, github.com/github/gh-aw-firewall), the default sandbox. Filesystem is asymmetric: `$HOME`, `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE`, `/tmp` read-write; `/usr`, `/opt`, `/bin`, `/lib` read-only; `/var/run/docker.sock` hidden. Egress: AWF puts the agent on an internal Docker network `awf-net` with a Squid proxy as the sole exit; `network.allowed` takes ecosystem bundles (`defaults`, `python`, `node`, `rust`, `containers`, engine bundles `copilot`/`claude`/`codex`/`gemini`) plus literal domains and single-leading-wildcard patterns; `network.blocked` wins; `firewall.ssl-bump: true` enables URL-path-level filtering via `allow-urls`. Port exposure needs an explicit `services:` declaration or the `allow-host-ports` escape hatch under `runtime: docker-sudo-iptables`. Alternative runtimes: gVisor (deprecated) and cloud-hypervisor (KVM, preview). Disabling the sandbox "removes a security trust boundary and is only supported when `strict: false`".
why_it_works_zh: 出口白名单是防外泄的唯一真正有效的手段——你挡不住模型被说服，但你可以让它无处可发。把代理做成网络拓扑上的唯一出口（而不是环境变量里的 HTTP_PROXY），意味着 agent 就算显式绕过代理设置也出不去。隐藏 docker.sock 则堵住了「容器内拿到 docker 就等于拿到宿主」这条经典逃逸路径。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署 agent 出口白名单应该只有四类：GitHub API、目标 EC2 的 SSH 端口（而且是按本次部署目标动态放行，不是整段 VPC）、包镜像源、Slack webhook。任何其它出站一律拒绝并记账。特别注意：FeedMob 本地 launchd 那一层现在完全没有出口控制，把本地 agent 收进 Orrery 时应该同样用容器 + 代理出口，而不是让 claude/codex 命令在裸 macOS 上自由联网。

why_it_works_zh: 两点值得学：第一，firewall_diff 和 domain_inventory 意味着「这次运行访问的域名和上次不一样」是一个可以被自动发现的事实——这是对提示注入最实用的事后检测手段，比任何静态扫描都管用。第二，cluster_analysis 把「这次运行行为上跟历史不同」做成了一等信号，而不是让人去翻日志找感觉。

claim_zh: 把「工作流跑成功了」和「它做的事被接受了」拆成两个独立概念：safe output 记录 agent 做了什么，outcome 记录仓库事后处于什么状态，而且明确写死「工作流不决定自己是否成功，仓库状态决定」。
mechanism_en: Six outcome states per produced item: `accepted` (kept/merged/completed), `rejected` (explicitly undone/closed/removed), `pending` (exists, not terminal), `ignored` (no meaningful follow-up within the evaluation window), `lifecycle` (closed by the workflow itself as normal operation), `lifecycle_close` (bot-initiated close with no non-bot reopen). Recorded fields per item: `object_url`, `outcome_status`, `evidence_strength`, plus object type, comments, review activity and zero-touch acceptance in telemetry spans. CLI: `gh aw outcomes <run-id>`, `--json`, `--outcomes-dir ./outcomes` for per-item JSONL. Docs state: "Outcomes describe what happened after a safe output landed in a repository… The workflow does not decide whether it succeeded; the repository state does."
why_it_works_zh: 这是 FeedMob「投递≠成功≠综合」那条教训的最彻底版本。FeedMob 发现的是 Slack channel_not_found 但 job 成功，所以「这三件事分开报」；GitHub 更进一步：连「PR 开出来了」都不算成功，得看它有没有被 merge，而且专门区分了 rejected（被人否掉）和 ignored（没人理）——后者是 agent 自动化最常见也最难看见的失败模式。evidence_strength 这个字段承认了「我对这个判定有多确定」本身也需要被记录。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署服务必须有三层独立终态：(1) 执行结果——SSH 上去跑完了吗；(2) 投递结果——Slack/Mobius 通知发出去了吗（可独立重试，带死信）；(3) 采纳结果——这次部署最后是被保留了还是被回滚了。第三层正是 gh-aw 的 outcome，对应到部署就是「部署后 N 分钟内有没有紧急回滚」，这才是衡量 agent 部署质量的真指标。ignored 这个状态映射到部署域是「部署完没人看健康检查」，也该被记账。

claim_zh: gh aw compile 把 Markdown 编译成一个 .lock.yml，编译过程有一步专门是「把所有 action 引用解析成 commit SHA」，并把解析结果缓存进一个应当提交到版本库的 .github/aw/actions-lock.json；运行时 activation job 还会校验 lock 文件是否与源文件一致，不一致就不往下跑。
mechanism_en: Five compile phases: Parsing & Validation (frontmatter schema, expression-safety checks, import resolution) → Job Construction (pre-activation, activation, agent, detection, safe-outputs jobs) → Dependency Resolution (cycle detection, topological order) → **Action Pinning** (every action resolved to a commit SHA) → YAML Generation (lock file with metadata header, Mermaid dependency graph, alphabetically ordered jobs, MCP config embedded as JSON, original markdown embedded as a comment). SHA resolution order: `.github/aw/actions-lock.json` cache → GitHub API → embedded fallback pins, with a version comment appended for humans. Docs: "Commit `actions-lock.json` to version control so every contributor and automated tool uses the same immutable pins." Drift detection via a frontmatter hash in the lock header, a workflow manifest tracking imported files, and lock-file freshness validation in the `activation` job. Flags: `--no-emit`, `--validate`, `--strict`, `--verbose`. Remote imports pin too: `owner/repo/path@v2.1.0|@main|@abc1234` resolved at compile time.
why_it_works_zh: FeedMob 现在 27 处 action 按可变 tag 引用、无一钉 SHA，这是个纯粹的供应链敞口。gh-aw 的答案不是「请大家记得钉 SHA」，而是把钉 SHA 变成编译器的一个不可跳过的阶段——人写的永远是 tag，编译产物永远是 SHA。更妙的是 activation job 会校验 lock 的新鲜度：契约先于代码，而且运行时强制。
orrery_mapping: 这是 Orrery 最该无条件抄的一条，而且能一次性消灭 FeedMob 三个已知问题：把 deploy.yml 这类工作流写成声明式源文件，由 orrery compile 生成锁定产物，编译阶段强制注入 timeout-minutes（补上 12 个缺失的）、concurrency（补上 7 个缺失的）、permissions（补上 6 个缺失的）、并把所有 action 解析成 SHA（补上 27 处）。8 个仓库同一套部署动作各写一遍的问题，用 imports 的 owner/repo/path@sha 语法解决：部署逻辑写一份，8 个仓库按 SHA 引用。锁定产物必须提交并在运行时校验新鲜度。

claim_zh: 提供一个「跑完全程但不落地」的 staged 模式：agent 照常分析、照常产出 safe outputs，但所有写操作被跳过，改为渲染到 Actions step summary 供人预览；而且可以按输出类型分别 staged，比如 PR 先预览、评论照常发。
mechanism_en: `safe-outputs: {staged: true}` globally, or per handler: `create-pull-request: {staged: true}` while `add-comment` executes for real. Staged runs need no credentials at all and produce sections like "Staged Mode: Issue Creation Preview" listing operation type, target, every populated field, and a count. The docs place this on a four-rung rollout ladder: report-only → staged ("answers what the workflow would do") → shadow evaluation (real write path against non-production targets, to validate concurrency/permissions/cross-repo behavior) → direct production writes. Rollout principles stated: production stays the source of truth; predictions are recorded at decision time for later comparison; corrections carry provenance (actor type, source, trust status); evaluation surfaces stay thin and temporary. Complementing this, `gh aw trial` runs a workflow in a temporary private repository before it touches the real one.
why_it_works_zh: 「apply 前有 plan 预览」这件事最难的不是技术，是让预览便宜到人愿意用——staged 模式不需要凭据，意味着任何人都能跑一遍看 agent 想干什么，不用先申请权限。分级 staged（PR 预览但评论照发）承认了一个现实：同一个 workflow 里不同动作的危险度差好几个数量级。四级爬梯 + gh aw trial 的临时私有仓库，让「先在别处试」成为有工具支持的默认路径而不是纪律要求。
orrery_mapping: 部署服务的 plan/apply 分离直接照此设计：orrery deploy --staged 输出「我将把 sha abc123 部署到 prod-web-1、prod-web-2，执行 migration X，预计停机 0 秒」，渲染成 Slack 消息或 PR 评论，不需要任何 SSH 凭据就能跑。分级 staged 映射为：生产部署默认 staged，staging 部署默认直接执行。爬梯的第三级 shadow 对应到 FeedMob 就是先对一台非生产 EC2 跑真实 SSH 路径——这恰好能提前暴露 2026-09-02 那次 known_hosts 失败，而不用推一次看一次。

mechanism_en: `safe-outputs: {environment: production, ...}` puts the safe-outputs job into a GitHub deployment environment. Environments provide: required reviewers ("Up to 6 people or teams", "only one of the required reviewers needs to approve the job for it to proceed"), a **Prevent self-review** setting that blocks "users from approving workflow runs that they triggered", a wait timer, deployment branch/tag policies with name-pattern matching, admin bypass, and custom deployment protection rules implemented as GitHub Apps. Environment secrets are gated by the same rules: "workflow jobs that use this environment can only access these secrets after any configured rules… pass". Separately, Copilot coding agent PRs get a hard gate: "Actions workflows triggered by pull requests raised by the agent require approval from a user with write access before they will run."
why_it_works_zh: 两个设计决定值得学。第一，审批门是服务端强制的，不是 UI 便利——它挡的是 job 启动，agent 无法绕过（对比 GitHub 自己在 Issues agent 审批那边明确承认「不是安全控制」，见 counter_evidence）。第二，Prevent self-review 直接对应 FeedMob 章程里的「审批者≠请求者」，而且它把密钥和审批绑在一起：审批没过，environment secrets 根本不下发——审批门同时是密钥门。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的生产部署审批必须同构：审批通过之前，执行 job 拿不到 SSH 私钥（而不是拿到了但被要求别用）。把「审批者≠请求者」做成数据库约束而不是 UI 提示——Mobius 已经有 DB 层互斥约束的先例，同一手法。审批发生在人已经在的地方：Slack 按钮或 PR review，而不是一个新后台。wait timer 也值得抄：给生产部署配一个可配置的冷静期，紧急部署可由 admin bypass 但留痕。

claim_zh: Copilot coding agent 是一个有身份但被结构性削权的主体：commit 由 Copilot 署名、发起任务的人被记为 co-author、commit 加密签名显示 Verified；同时它不能批准 PR、不能推默认分支（只能推 copilot/ 前缀分支或它自己那条 PR 分支）、它开的 PR 上的 Actions 必须有写权限的人批准才跑、它只能访问它正在开 PR 的那一个仓库。
mechanism_en: Attribution: "The cloud agent's commits are authored by Copilot, with the human who started the task marked as the co-author", cryptographically signed and shown as Verified. Powers withheld: it "cannot approve pull requests"; "Actions workflows triggered by pull requests raised by the agent require approval from a user with write access before they will run"; "It can only push to a single branch: the existing pull request branch when triggered via `@copilot`, or otherwise to a new `copilot/` branch. This means that Copilot cannot push directly to your default branch"; "The cloud agent only has access to the repository where it is creating a pull request and cannot access other repositories." Its auth token scope is "limited to the repository where it's running". Session control: the agents panel at github.com/copilot/agents shows reasoning, tool use, token usage and session length, with a **Stop session** button that "ends the GitHub Actions run and preserves any commits already pushed".
why_it_works_zh: 「agent 署名 + 人类 co-author」这一对恰好实现了 FeedMob 那句「分配给人、委派给 agent——agent 无法被追责」：署名让你知道是机器干的，co-author 让你知道该找谁负责，两者在同一个 commit 对象上，不需要查别的表。而「不能批准 PR、不能推 main、它的 PR 上的 CI 要人批」这三条是一组：它们共同保证 agent 无论多聪明都无法闭环地把代码送进生产，必须有人类在链条上按一下。
orrery_mapping: Mobius 的五种身份已经解决了主体建模，Orrery 要补的是「削权」这一半：部署 agent 的签名 commit / 部署记录必须携带发起人的 co-author 字段；agent 不能审批自己发起的部署；agent 触发的 CI 在生产分支上需要人类放行。特别把「它只能访问它正在操作的那一个仓库」翻译到部署域：一次部署运行拿到的 SSH 凭据只对本次目标主机有效，不是一把通吃 8 个仓库 N 台 EC2 的万能钥匙。

mechanism_en: "Copilot cloud agent has its own dedicated Agents secrets and variables, alongside the existing Actions, Codespaces, and Dependabot types", configurable at org or repo level. "Copilot cloud agent does not have access to GitHub Actions, Codespaces, or Dependabot secrets and variables. Only Agents secrets and variables are passed to the agent." Naming rules forbid the `GITHUB_` prefix. "Variables and secrets that you configure are exposed to Copilot as environment variables, except secrets and variables prefixed with `COPILOT_MCP_`, which are only available to MCP servers" (e.g. `COPILOT_MCP_SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN`). On the gh-aw side the same split exists: `safe-outputs.env` carries Jira credentials into the safe-outputs job only ("not exposed to the agent"), and the MCP gateway passes secrets into server containers via the `env` field rather than into the agent context, while the gateway spec requires it "MUST NOT log agent identifiers in plaintext".
why_it_works_zh: 这是「密钥不进模型上下文」这条原则被做成了基础设施而不是纪律：不是「请不要把密钥放进 prompt」，而是 agent 那个进程根本就读不到那批环境变量。COPILOT_MCP_ 前缀这个设计尤其经济——用命名约定表达信任边界，零配置成本，且一眼可审计（看名字就知道这个密钥会不会被模型看到）。

claim_zh: 「这次什么都没变 / 我不需要做任何事」被做成了一等的输出类型 noop，和 missing-tool、missing-data 一起自动启用；配合按标题去重（支持编辑距离阈值）和自动过期，让「无事发生」成为一条可查询的记录而不是日志里的沉默。
mechanism_en: Auto-enabled system output types: `noop` (completion logging, max 1), `missing-tool` (unlimited), `missing-data` (unlimited). Per-workflow opt-out with `safe-outputs: {noop: {report-as-issue: false}}`. Idempotency helpers on `create-issue`: `deduplicate-by-title: true` (exact) or `deduplicate-by-title: 1` (allow 1-char edit distance), `close-older-issues: true`, `group: true` (nest as sub-issues under a parent via a `gh-aw-group` marker), `expires: 7 | "2w" | "1m" | false`. Observed in production in github/gh-aw's own repo: issue #48838 "[aw] No-Op Runs" is a sticky issue that every no-op run comments on — it has accumulated 2500 comments; its body explains "A no-op (no operation) occurs when an agentic workflow runs successfully but determines that no action is required… These are successful outcomes, not failures". Persistence across runs uses `tools.repo-memory: true`, which auto-commits files to an orphan branch `memory/default`, replaying concurrent pushes onto the latest remote state ("your file changes win"), with `max-file-size` 100KB default, `max-file-count` 100, `max-patch-size` 10KB, `file-glob`, `allowed-extensions` and a `validation.script` hook.
why_it_works_zh: 把「没变化」显式记账，正面价值是能区分「跑了但不需要动」和「根本没跑」——这是 FeedMob cron 三段链（脚本 job 写内容哈希状态文件 → LLM job 在哈希未变时 no-op）想要的同一件事，但 gh-aw 把它提升成了平台原语而不是每个 workflow 自己实现。missing-tool / missing-data 这两个类型更值得注意：它们让「agent 想做但做不到」也变成结构化数据，这是发现能力缺口的唯一可靠途径。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的运行契约里加三个系统级终态：noop（带内容哈希，说明为什么判定无变化）、missing-tool、missing-data。FeedMob 现有的 cron 三段链可以直接退化成「引擎原生支持 no-op」，不再每个脚本自己写状态文件。部署域的具体落法：orrery 检测到目标主机上已经是这个 sha 时产出 noop 而不是重新部署，且这条 noop 带 sha 作为幂等键。注意别抄 2500 条评论堆在一个 issue 上的呈现方式（见 research_notes）。

claim_zh: 编译器按触发器类型自动生成 concurrency group 与重叠策略，人不用写也不会漏：PR 触发用 cancel-in-progress（新 commit 取消旧运行），issue/push/schedule 用 queue: max 排队而不是丢弃，另外还有一层按引擎的并发组 gh-aw-{engine-id}。
mechanism_en: Auto-generated groups: issues → `gh-aw-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ issue.number }}`; PRs → `gh-aw-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ pr.number || ref }}`; push → `gh-aw-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}`; schedule/other → `gh-aw-${{ github.workflow }}`. Cancel-in-progress is on for PR and label-on-PR triggers only; issues, push and schedule use `queue: max`. A second, per-engine group `gh-aw-{engine-id}` serialises AI execution. Scheduled runs all share one group by default, so `concurrency.job-discriminator: ${{ github.run_id }}` is the documented escape hatch to let them run in parallel. Complementary throttles: `user-rate-limit.max-runs-per-window` (1–10, window ≤180 min, `ignored-roles` defaults to `[admin, maintain, write]`), a built-in 10-second delay between agent assignments and 5 seconds between workflow dispatches.
why_it_works_zh: 最值得学的是「默认值由编译器生成」这个姿态。FeedMob 13 个 workflow 里 7 个没有 concurrency，原因不是工程师不懂，是没人有精力给每个文件补。把并发策略做成编译期自动推导（按触发器类型选择取消还是排队），漏配就在架构上变成不可能。而「PR 取消、schedule 排队」这个默认选择也是对的：PR 的旧运行确实无价值，定时任务的旧运行丢了就是数据缺口。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 编译器对部署工作流强制生成并发组，且默认策略必须按部署目标区分：同一台主机的部署串行排队（queue，绝不能 cancel——取消一半的部署比排队危险得多），不同主机的部署可并行。这直接对应 2026-09-02 那次「两次部署失败连带三个 release job」的场景：如果并发组按目标主机而不是按仓库划分，三个 release job 不会被一起拖下水。另外把 user-rate-limit 抄过来，防止运营同事在 Slack 里连点十次部署。

claim_zh: 引擎是 per-run 可插拔的一个 frontmatter 块：engine.id 在 copilot / claude / codex / gemini / pi 之间切换，还能钉引擎 CLI 版本、改模型、换 CLI 路径与参数、指向企业 endpoint；BYO key 走 engine.env，Copilot 甚至能通过 COPILOT_PROVIDER_* 系列变量反向挂到 Anthropic 等第三方提供商上。
mechanism_en:
```yaml
engine:
  id: copilot        # copilot(default) | claude | codex | gemini | pi
  version: "0.0.422" # pin the engine CLI release
  model: gpt-5
  command: /path/to/cli
  args: ["--verbose"]
  api-target: api.example.com
  env: {DEBUG_MODE: "true"}
```
Auth per engine: Copilot via the `copilot-requests: write` permission or `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`; Claude via `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or Anthropic Workload Identity Federation; Codex via `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`CODEX_API_KEY`; Gemini via `GEMINI_API_KEY` or Google WIF. BYOK through Copilot: `COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL`, `COPILOT_MODEL`, `COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY`, `COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE: anthropic`. Third-party engines can be imported and referenced by `engine.id`. Billing follows the key: Copilot inference bills as org AI Credits when `copilot-requests: write` is declared, otherwise Claude/OpenAI/Google bill directly to your account with your key. Capability gaps are documented, not hidden: custom agents / custom harness / `max-continuations` are Copilot-only, native web search is Claude+Codex only, per-command bash allowlist is unavailable on Codex, MCP is unavailable on Pi — "Not all features are available across all engines."
why_it_works_zh: FeedMob 现在同时跑 Claude Code、Codex、pi、Hermes 四个运行时，这条维度是刚需。gh-aw 的做法有两点做对了：(1) 引擎 CLI 的版本本身可以钉死（engine.version），这意味着引擎升级不会静默改变你的运行行为——这跟钉 action SHA 是同一个原则；(2) 它明确列出了跨引擎的能力差异表而不是假装引擎都一样，这让「相同运行契约」这件事变得诚实：契约相同，能力集不同，差异可见。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 run spec 里 engine 应是一个同构的块：{id, version, model, env}，其中 version 钉引擎 CLI 版本。Hermes 作为 FeedMob 自研的运行时，应该以「第三方引擎」的方式接入同一契约（gh-aw 支持 import 第三方 engine 并按 engine.id 引用），而不是另起一套。计费跟着 key 走这条也要抄：谁的 key 谁付钱，成本记录里带上 key 归属，这样运营同事用 agent 的钱能算到他们团队头上。同时必须像 gh-aw 一样公开维护一张跨引擎能力差异表。

claim_zh: 企业/组织/仓库三级用 GitHub Actions variables 下发策略：GH_AW_DEFAULT_* 设默认值，GH_AW_POLICY_* 是布尔能力开关，可以在不重新编译任何 workflow 的情况下全组织关掉某类写能力，safe-outputs 启动时发现被策略禁止就拒绝运行。
mechanism_en: Two families of Actions variables scoped at enterprise / org / repo: `GH_AW_DEFAULT_*` (per-engine model selection, total and daily AI credit limits, timeout, max turns, UTC offset) and `GH_AW_POLICY_*` — "boolean capability gates that allow or deny specific runtime behaviors without recompiling workflows", e.g. `GH_AW_POLICY_ALLOW_CREATE_PULL_REQUEST="false"` makes "the system refuse to start safe-outputs if the policy blocks that capability". Precedence, most specific first: workflow frontmatter → repository variable → organization variable → enterprise variable → built-in compiler fallback. Orgs can additionally "require one or more checks produced by agentic workflows" via GitHub rulesets, injecting review automation across repos without per-repo setup. Caveat stated in the docs: some policies are compile-time (max turns, detection model) and must be passed into CI compile steps.
why_it_works_zh: 「不重编译就能全局关闭一类能力」是一个真正的 kill switch，而绝大多数自动化平台没有——它们的开关要么是「停掉整个 workflow」（太粗），要么要改代码再发布（太慢）。把它做成布尔能力门而不是配置值，意味着紧急情况下的操作是原子的、可立即生效的、且不依赖任何人重新编译。清晰的五级优先级则让「谁能覆盖谁」不需要靠猜。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 需要一个同构的运行时策略层：ORRERY_POLICY_ALLOW_PROD_DEPLOY、ORRERY_POLICY_ALLOW_MIGRATION 之类的布尔门，工作区/团队/仓库三级，改一个值就能在不碰任何代码的前提下全公司冻结生产部署。这正好补上 2026-08-19 那次「GitHub 消费上限被顶穿且静默」的反面：出事时你需要的是一个能立刻按下去的开关，而不是去 8 个仓库改 13 个文件。同时把 gh-aw 那条自认的坑记下来——编译期策略和运行期策略要分清，编译期的那些必须在 CI 的 compile 步骤里注入，否则策略会静默失效。

claim_zh: Kamal 把「切流量」做成一条阻塞式、由健康检查门控、且等旧实例排空后才返回的命令 kamal-proxy deploy <service> --target host:port，失败返回非零退出码。
mechanism_en: `kamal-proxy deploy <service> --target <host>:<port>` registers the new instance, immediately starts HTTP health checks (default `GET /up` once per second, 200 = healthy; tunable via `--health-check-path`, `--health-check-port`, `--health-check-timeout`, `--health-check-interval`), routes new traffic only after healthy, then **waits for traffic to drain from the old instance before returning** — "it's safe to remove the old instance as soon as `deploy` returns successfully". "If the instance fails to become healthy within a reasonable time, the `deploy` command will stop the deployment and return a non-zero exit code." Kamal drives it from `Kamal::Cli::App::Boot#start_new_version`: `execute *app.run(hostname:)` → `endpoint = capture(*app.container_id_for_version(version))` → `execute *app.deploy(target: endpoint)`; flags come from `Kamal::Configuration::Proxy#deploy_options` = `deploy-timeout`, `drain-timeout`, `health-check-interval`, `health-check-timeout`, `health-check-path`, `target-timeout`, `buffer-*`, `error-pages`.
why_it_works_zh: 「容器起来了」「能服务了」「旧的已收尾」是三件事，它把三件事压进一条会失败的命令，退出码就是唯一真相，调用方不需要自己 sleep+curl 拼一个假的成功信号。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 DeployRun 必须把「切流」建模成独立 step，成功条件是 proxy 返回 0，而不是 SSH 命令返回 0。FeedMob 现在 deploy.yml 里 SSH 跑完即成功，正是「投递≠成功」在部署侧的翻版。deploy_timeout / drain_timeout 提升为 DeployTarget 的一等字段，超时即失败并入台账。

claim_zh: 「什么版本跑在哪台机器」是一条原生查询命令 kamal app version（逐主机打印）；漂移检测是 kamal app stale_containers，把每台主机上所有 app 容器版本减去「当前运行版本」，且 kamal deploy 每次开跑前都会自动带 --stop 执行一次。
mechanism_en: `Kamal::Cli::App#version` (desc "Show app version currently running on servers"): `on(KAMAL.app_hosts) do |host| role = KAMAL.roles_on(host).first; puts_by_host host, capture_with_info(*KAMAL.app(role:, host:).current_running_version).strip end`. `#stale_containers`: `versions = capture(*app.list_versions).split("\n"); versions -= [ capture(*app.current_running_version).strip ]`, then `execute *app.stop(version:)` when `--stop`. `Kamal::Cli::Main#deploy` runs `invoke "kamal:cli:app:stale_containers", [], invoke_options.merge(stop: true)` before `app:boot`. `kamal details` = `proxy:details` + `app:details` + `accessory:details all`.
why_it_works_zh: 版本归属是查询而不是推理；而且漂移检测不是另设的巡检任务，而是部署流程的固定一步，所以它永远不会陈旧——这正是 FeedMob cron 三段链要解决的那个失效模式。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 必须提供 `orrery deploy status <service> -d prod`，逐主机返回 (版本, 容器 id, 启动时间, 健康)，并把这张表写进运行契约尾标与 AgentRun 镜像表。stale 检测放进部署前置步骤而非独立 cron。

claim_zh: 跳板机是一等配置 ssh.proxy: user@host（映射到 Net::SSH::Proxy::Jump），私钥可来自密钥管理器（key_data 填 secret 名），默认开 keepalive: true / keepalive_interval: 30；但主机指纹验证它完全不管，整条 options 里根本没有 verify_host_key，甩给 net-ssh 与本机 ~/.ssh/config。

claim_zh: 敏感值是一个类型而不是一个约定：Kamal::Utils::Sensitive 包装类 include SSHKit::Redaction 让 SSHKit 在命令日志里自动打码，encode_with 保证 dump 成 YAML 时也只输出 [REDACTED]；密钥不进 docker run 命令行，而是以 mode 0600 逐主机上传成 env 文件。
mechanism_en:
```ruby
class Kamal::Utils::Sensitive
  include SSHKit::Redaction   # So SSHKit knows to redact these values.
  attr_reader :unredacted, :redaction
  delegate :to_s, to: :unredacted
  delegate :inspect, to: :redaction
  def encode_with(coder) = coder.represent_scalar nil, redaction  # won't leak into YAML
end
```
`Kamal::Utils.argumentize(arg, attrs, sensitive: true)` wraps as `sensitive("#{key}=#{value}", redaction: "#{key}=[REDACTED]")`; `Kamal::Utils.redacted(value)` walks hashes/arrays recursively. Two boolean rules: `approve` ("The run is approved and no longer requires (or allows) review") and `reject` ("The run fails immediately").   some approval in input.reviews.current.approvals

```rego
}
```

claim_zh: Atlantis 把「什么时候才允许 apply」收敛成三个可组合的前置条件——approved（至少一个非作者本人的人批准）、mergeable（PR 在平台侧确实可合并：分支保护、状态检查、无冲突）、undiverged（自最近一次 plan 以来 base 分支没变），默认在服务端 repos.yaml 定义，仓库内 atlantis.yaml 只有被 allowed_overrides 显式允许才能覆盖。
mechanism_en:
Keys: `plan_requirements`, `apply_requirements`, `import_requirements`; values `approved` | `mergeable` | `undiverged`. "The `approved` requirement will prevent applies unless the pull request is approved by at least one person other than the author." "The `mergeable` requirement will prevent applies unless a pull request is able to be merged." `undiverged`: "Prevent applies if there are any changes on the base branch since the most recent plan" (only with the `merge` checkout strategy). Server-side:
```yaml
repos:
- id: /.*/
  plan_requirements: [approved]
  apply_requirements: [mergeable]
  allowed_overrides: [plan_requirements, apply_requirements, import_requirements]
```
why_it_works_zh: undiverged 这条最值钱——它承认「我审的那个 plan 已经过期了」是一种独立的失败模式，而不是靠人记得重新看一眼。allowed_overrides 则让默认策略住在平台侧，仓库不能自行放宽，只能在白名单内动。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署审批必须有 undiverged 语义：审批的是某一次 plan 的产出（镜像 sha + 渲染配置哈希），主干在审批期间前进则审批自动失效、需重新 plan。FeedMob「13 个 workflow 各写一遍、12 个没 timeout、6 个没 permissions」的问题正好用 allowed_overrides 模型解：平台给基线，仓库只能在显式白名单内覆盖。

claim_zh: Managed Agents 把「这次 run 最多花多少钱」做成创建时的一等参数 budget.max_list_cost，用整数美分字符串表达以杜绝浮点舍入，触顶时会话不是终止而是转 idle 并给出专属 stop_reason budget_reached，且只接受结算类事件、拒绝任何会开新工的事件。
mechanism_en: POST /v1/sessions accepts `budget: {type: "limit", max_list_cost: {amount: "2500", currency: "USD"}}`. `amount` is a whole number of US cents **as a string** ("125" = $1.25); "25.00", zero and negative are 400-rejected; USD only. List cost is metered continuously over three components: model tokens at each served model's list price, web searches at $10 per 1,000, and session running time at $0.08 per hour. Enforcement happens *between* model requests, so the request that crosses the cap completes and the recorded `list_cost` can land a fraction past `max_list_cost` (a session capped at "50" can pause at "53") — overshoot is bounded by one model request per thread. On reaching the cap the stream emits, in order: `session.thread_status_idle` with `stop_reason: budget_reached` per thread, then a `session.usage` snapshot, then `session.status_idle` with `stop_reason: budget_reached`. While at the cap only settle events are accepted: `user.tool_confirmation`, `user.tool_result`, `user.custom_tool_result`, `user.interrupt`; `user.message` is 400-rejected naming that list. Raising or nulling `budget` auto-resumes; the new cap must be strictly greater than consumed list cost. Budget removal is one-way. Deployments accept the same object and copy it onto each run (per-run, not cumulative).
why_it_works_zh: 它把 FeedMob 三重硬停里最难做对的一重——美元——做成了引擎原生谓词，而不是外部扫描推导。三个设计决策值得抄：(1) 整数美分字符串，彻底消灭「30 天成本靠扫 3000 条评论推导而静默少报」那类精度与口径漂移；(2) 触顶是 pause 不是 kill，sandbox 与历史保留，改预算即续跑，避免了「一刀切死导致现场丢失」；(3) 触顶后只收结算事件、拒收新工，这让「触顶」变成一个可判定的状态机位置，而不是一条日志行。更关键的是它主动承认了 overshoot 有界（每线程一次模型请求），把不精确写进契约而不是藏起来。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 RunBudget 直接抄这套语义：budget 字段用 integer cents + currency，禁止小数；触顶写 stopReason='budget_reached' 而不是把 run 标 failed；触顶后的 run 进入 paused 态，只接受 approve/deny/tool_result/stop 四类事件，任何 enqueue 新任务的调用返回 400 并在错误里列出被允许的事件名。同时抄它的「预算只能在创建时挂、之后可改可删但不可重新添加」的单向约束——这能防止运维在事后给一个失控 run 补一个假的上限来掩盖问题。deployment 级预算 copy 到每次 run 而非累计，这一点要照抄：FeedMob 的 maxCostUsdPerHour 是窗口语义，而部署服务需要的是「每次部署最多花多少」，两者都要有。

claim_zh: Managed Agents 的停止是显式两阶段：user.interrupt 发出即返回（只是入队），processed_at 保持 null 直到 agent 真正应用，会话在此期间保持 running，应用后该 interrupt 事件本身落到事件流上作为确认，再由 session.status_idle 收尾——你能读到「请求」与「已生效」两个时刻。
mechanism_en: `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/events` with `{"type": "user.interrupt"}`. Per the docs: "The call returns as soon as the events are queued, and the interrupt's `processed_at` stays null until the agent applies it. A model response in progress stops immediately. The interrupt can take longer to apply while tool calls are running, and the session stays `running` until it does. The `user.interrupt` event then appears on the stream, and the interrupted turn ends with a `session.status_idle` event." An interrupt can be batched with a redirect in one call: `[{type:"user.interrupt"}, {type:"user.message", content:[...]}]` — the agent begins its next turn with that message. Archive and delete both refuse a `running` session and the documented procedure is: send `user.interrupt` alone, wait for `idle`, then act. Updating `agent.tools` / `agent.mcp_servers` mid-session has the same precondition.
why_it_works_zh: 这是 FeedMob stopRequestedAt / stopAckedAt 双列的外部印证，而且更进一步：确认不是一个布尔列，而是【同一条事件对象上的时间戳从 null 变为有值】，加上这条事件在流上的出现本身。这样「请求」与「确认」共用一个 id，不可能对不上号。另一个被验证的设计是：状态转移的前置条件被写进 API（running 不能 archive / delete / update tools），强制调用方走「停→确认 idle→再操作」，而不是允许并发操作制造竞态——FeedMob 那次「紧急停止导致两次生产对话永久失声」正是闩锁释放路径不全造成的。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 StopRequest 做成一条事件行而不是 run 表上的两列：stop_request 事件带 id、requested_at，acked_at 从 null 被就地更新；「已确认」的判定是 acked_at IS NOT NULL 而不是另一张表的另一行。同时把前置条件写进 API：run 处于 running 时拒绝 archive / 改配置 / 删除，错误信息直接告诉调用方发 stop 并等 idle。但必须补上 Anthropic 缺的那一块——见 counter_evidence 第一条：Orrery 的 stop_reason 必须区分 completed / stopped_by_human / stopped_by_budget / stopped_by_timeout，绝不能让被打断的 run 报成和自然结束同值。

claim_zh: Managed Agents 不另设日志系统：session 的持久化事件流【就是】运行台账，人在 session URL 上看的和机器 events.list 拉的是同一串带 id 的事件，里面同时含模型用量、每次工具调用的权限判定结果与判定理由码、以及累计成本快照。
mechanism_en: Events are persisted server-side and fetched with `client.beta.sessions.events.list(session_id, types=[...])`. Typed families: `agent.tool_use` / `agent.mcp_tool_use` carry `evaluated_permission` (`"allow"|"ask"|"deny"`) plus an `evaluation` object whose `type` names the policy that produced it and, under `auto`, a `reason_code` such as `"high_risk"` or `"indeterminate"`; `span.model_request_start` / `span.model_request_end` wrap each inference with `model_usage` token counts; `session.usage` snapshots cumulative `list_cost`, `active_seconds`, `server_tool_use.web_search_requests` / `web_fetch_requests` and echoes the `budget`; `agent.thread_context_compacted` marks compaction; `session.status_idle` carries `stop_reason`. Content the model policy withholds appears as an explicit `{"type": "redacted"}` block rather than silently vanishing. Rate limits: 300 create req/min, 1,200 read req/min per org.
why_it_works_zh: 这正是 FeedMob「评论是真源、AgentRun 表同事务镜像」的成熟形态：一本账，两种读法，没有第二份可能漂移的副本。三个细节特别值得学：(1) 权限判定的【结果】和【理由码】写进运行记录本身，而不是只留在策略引擎里——事后审计「为什么这个 rm -rf 被拦了」不用去翻另一个系统；(2) reason_code 明说是给客户端分支和存档用的、不是给终端用户显示的文案，等于把机器可读与人可读的职责分清楚了；(3) redacted 是一个显式块，缺失被记录为「此处有内容被扣下」而不是留白——沉默的缺失是 FeedMob 最痛的那类 bug。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 RunEvent 表照这个 schema 设计：每条 event 有稳定 id、type（domain.action 命名）、processed_at；工具调用事件必须带 evaluated_permission + evaluation.reason_code；每次模型调用配一对 span 事件带 token 计数；每次 run 转 idle/终态前强制先写一条 usage 快照事件（Anthropic 的原话是 usage 事件总是紧邻 idle 事件之前，这条不变量直接抄）。HTML 注释尾标 <!--mobius-agent ...--> 保留为人可读投影，但真源换成 RunEvent 流，尾标由流派生。扣留内容用显式 redacted 块，禁止留白。

claim_zh: Managed Agents 的审批门是一等会话状态而不是外挂：需要人批的工具调用让会话以 stop_reason.type = requires_action 转 idle，并在 stop_reason.event_ids 里列出到底是哪几个调用在等，会话【无限期等待】不超时自毁；答复用 user.tool_confirmation 事件带 allow/deny 和 deny_message。
mechanism_en: Three policies: `always_allow`, `always_ask`, `auto`. Defaults differ by toolset kind — the agent toolset defaults to `always_allow`, MCP toolsets default to `always_ask` (so newly added MCP tools never auto-execute). Set at `default_config.permission_policy` for a whole toolset or per tool in `configs[]`. When a call evaluates to `ask`: the session emits `agent.tool_use`, then `session.status_idle` with `stop_reason.type: "requires_action"` and the blocking IDs in `stop_reason.event_ids`; "The session waits indefinitely for a response." Reply with `{type: "user.tool_confirmation", tool_use_id: <event id>, result: "allow"|"deny", deny_message: "..."}`; several can go in one request. Confirming an event whose `evaluated_permission` is not `ask` is 400-rejected — including calls `auto` denied, which the client cannot override. Docs carry an explicit Warning: "`auto` is not a human checkpoint. If the server determines that a call is safe, the call runs before anyone sees it." In multiagent sessions a pending `requires_action` outranks `budget_reached` at the session level.
why_it_works_zh: 它把「在等谁批什么」变成可查询状态而不是需要人重建的上下文：event_ids 明确指向具体调用，不是一句「有东西在等」。两个反直觉但正确的决策：(1) 无限期等待——不给审批门加超时自毁，因为超时自动放行等于没有门，超时自动失败等于把人的延迟变成 agent 的失败；升级靠外部调度器而不是内部计时器。(2) 官方主动用 Warning 声明 auto 不是人类检查点——这是厂商文档里罕见的自我否定，避免了运维把「服务器判安全」误当成「人看过了」。MCP toolset 默认 always_ask 也是对的：MCP 服务器随时会新增工具，默认放行等于把授权决定外包给第三方。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署审批门照抄这三件事：(1) run 转 waiting_approval 时必须写 pendingApprovalIds 数组，指向具体的待批动作（哪台机器、哪个 release），不是一个布尔；(2) 审批门不设内部超时，超时升级由 cron 层发 Slack 提醒并可选升级到 team-agent 的 manager，run 本身一直等；(3) 部署服务的 MCP / 外部工具默认 always_ask，只有显式进白名单的才 always_allow——这与 FeedMob 已有的「黑名单改空白名单」教训同向。审批者≠请求者这条 Anthropic 没做，Orrery 必须自己加：user.tool_confirmation 的等价物要带 approver 主体，且 DB 层约束 approver_id != requester_id。

claim_zh: Claude Code 云环境的 API credential 不是环境变量：密钥存在环境上，由 Anthropic 的 agent proxy 在请求【离开 session 的 VM 之后】按目标 host 注入，密钥从不进入 Claude 的上下文、不进入它跑的命令、也不出现在 session 的环境变量里。
mechanism_en: From the docs: "An API credential is an API key or token you store on a cloud environment so Claude can call that API from any session in the environment without seeing the key. Anthropic's agent proxy adds the key to requests for the hosts you list, after each request leaves the session's VM. The key never reaches Claude, the commands it runs, or the session's environment variables." Configured per credential with **Credential type** (default `Bearer`), **Allowed websites** (hosts; a leading `*.` matches subdomains), and **Custom headers** (header **Name** + **Prefix** + **Value**; clear the prefix for `X-Api-Key`-style bare values). No edit path: to change hosts or value you delete and re-add. Requires an organization admin role; not available on Team/Enterprise plans yet (the section is hidden there); unavailable when the org uses customer-managed encryption keys; the API must accept connections from the internet because requests egress from Anthropic's network. The docs explicitly contrast this with **Environment variables**, which are "visible to anyone who uses the environment".
why_it_works_zh: 这是 D8「密钥不进模型上下文」从一句原则变成一个可实施机制的样板。关键在注入点选在【VM 出口之后】：只要注入点在 agent 能触达的边界之内，无论白名单多严，一次成功的提示注入总能把密钥读走（这正是 FeedMob 把工具黑名单改成空白名单的原因——Read/WebFetch 留着活口就能读环境变量）。把注入点推到边界之外，读环境变量这条攻击路径在物理上就不存在了。「没有编辑、只能删了重加」也是对的：凭证的变更必须是一次可审计的替换，而不是一次静默的原地改写。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的部署服务按这个模型做 SecretBroker：EC2 的 SSH key、部署 token、第三方 API key 全部不进 agent 的环境变量与 prompt，改由 Orrery 的出口代理在请求离开 run 容器后按 host 注入。凭证记录带 allowed_hosts（支持 *.）、header name + prefix、created_by、created_at，不可编辑只可删除重建，每次替换写一条 activity。这也顺便解决 2026-09-02 那次 known_hosts 事故的一半：主机指纹与 SSH 凭证由 broker 统一持有，agent 只声明要连哪台，不再各仓库各写一遍。注意 Anthropic 这条 Team/Enterprise 还没有——Orrery 不受此限，这反而是自研的理由。

claim_zh: Managed Agents 的 self-hosted sandbox 把编排与执行切开：模型与状态机留在 Anthropic，文件系统、进程和网络出口留在你的机器上；你跑一个 worker 去 poll Anthropic 的工作队列，用 environment key 而不是你的 API key 认证，还能用 --on-work 为每个 work item 起一个一次性沙箱。
mechanism_en: Create an environment with `config: {type: self_hosted}`; sessions targeting it are enqueued in Anthropic's work queue. Run `ant beta:worker poll --workdir "/workspace"` (needs only outbound HTTPS), or the SDK `EnvironmentWorker(...).run()` / `.handle_item()`, or a webhook-triggered handler listening for `session.status_run_started` to avoid idle polling. Auth: `ANTHROPIC_ENVIRONMENT_ID` + `ANTHROPIC_ENVIRONMENT_KEY` (generated in Console only, not via API) — the docs say never put your Claude API key on the worker host. A claimed work item carries `id` (work ID), `data.id` (session ID) and a per-session `secret` used for memory mounts. Worker CLI flags: `--on-work` (script per claimed item, receives session details as env vars, enabling a fresh per-session sandbox), `--unrestricted-paths` (docs warn the workdir check "is a guardrail for the file tools only, not a sandbox; it does not constrain bash"), `--max-idle` (default `60s`), `--log-format json`. Data boundary: filesystem contents, spawned processes and internal network traffic stay on your host; tool inputs/outputs, skills and memory-store contents flow to Anthropic. The CLI worker does not mount memory stores — use the SDK worker for that.
why_it_works_zh: 这是整份调研里对「Orrery 与它们是互操作还是替代」最直接的答案：Managed Agents 主动把执行层让出来了。FeedMob 不必二选一——可以让 Anthropic 做 agent loop、预算计量和事件台账，而让 Orrery 做每个 run 的 microVM / 容器、按任务作用域的 token、出口 allowlist 和爆炸半径控制，这些恰好是 D13 里 Orrery 必须自己掌握的部分。另外一个诚实得罕见的细节：文档明说 --unrestricted-paths 的 workdir 检查只是文件工具的护栏、不约束 bash、不是沙箱——它拒绝把一个 guardrail 包装成 sandbox 来卖，这个措辞标准值得 Orrery 的文档照抄。
orrery_mapping: Orrery 的 P1 做一个 orrery-worker：在 EC2 上 poll Anthropic 的 environment work queue，每个 work item 用 --on-work 等价物拉起一个一次性容器（无环境凭据、按任务作用域 token、出口 allowlist），跑完即焚。这样 FeedMob 既拿到 Managed Agents 的 budget / events / interrupt 语义，又不把生产机器的文件系统和内网交给托管沙箱。认证严格分层：worker 持 environment key（作用域仅为「领这个环境的活」），绝不持 org 级 API key——这条直接写进章程。注意数据边界是真实成本：tool 的输入输出仍然流向 Anthropic，所以部署日志里的敏感字段要在 worker 侧脱敏后再回传，这是 Orrery 必须补的一层（对应 D9 的输出脱敏）。
